960: Kechivya, ad deappik nishmateh, vekatal leh.

Vechol millin ahadru lisoda kadmaa, vei lav dehava kayin mehahu sitra, la ishtechach hachi legabbe achu. veal da, kevan dechaza adam deitketil hevel, veitterich kayin, amar, ma ana olid mikkan ulehala, itperash meitteteh mea utelatin shenin, veruchin nukeve misave, havo atyayn umitchammeman minneh, vahava olid ruchin veshedin, veikrun nige bene adam, veokimna.

Levatar kane veitlabbash bekina, veitchabbar beitteteh, veolid leshet. dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:3) vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo vayyikra et shemo shet. da ihu bidmuto ketzalmo, ma dela hava hachi bekadmita, beinnun benin kadmae, dahavo mikkadmat dena.

Begin, deha bekadmita, itchabberuta achara havavt legabbeh, veukemuha, ad deatat chavva, veatkin lah kudesha berich hu legabbeh deadam, veitchabbaru anpin beanpin. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 2:23) lezot yikkare ishsha, da ihi itteta, aval achara la ikre hachi. veha ukemuha.
Uvegin kach, deadam vechavva kachada itberiu, ketiv (Bereshit Adonai:2) zachar unekeva beraam vayvarech otam, tarvavyyhu kachada havo. veal da ketiv, achor vakedem tzartani.

Ta chaze, efod vechoshen, achor vakedem havo, vechad kahana itlebash behu, hava dame bediyyukena illaa. veha ittemar, dichden anpoy nehirin, veatvavn baltin, vesallekin leella menaharan, ucheden hava yada milla.

Uvegin kach, tikkuna dechoshna, vetikkuna deefoda, kachada mitkashsheran. veaf al gav detikkuna deda lav ihu ketikkuna deda, vecholla beraza chada. kishshura deda beda, leitachada choshna beefoda, bearba izkan, deitkesharu behay atar, uvehay atar. veinnun raza deinnun retichin, demitkashsheran behay sitra diltatta, leinnun dilella, vecholla ihu beraza deofanin vechayyot.

Ketiv, bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz. veukemuha, deha kolla kegavvna da itavid mashkena, kegavvna dealma tattaa, avad kegavvna dealma illaa, vechol ovadoy deavad kegavvna dilella. hachi name mashkena, kol ovadoy innun keovada uchegavvna dealma (illaa). (sefer acher veukemuha kegavvna da itavid mashkena vechol ovadoy deavad behay alma kegavvna dilella eved. vehachi nammi mashkena kol ovadoy inun kegavvna dilella kegavvna dealma tattaa uchegavvna dealma ilaa)

Veraza da kol ovadin demashkena, kullehu ovadin vetikkunin dilella vetatta, begin leashraa shechinta bealma, bediurin illain, uvediurin tattain. kegavvna da, gan eden letatta, ihu kegavvna illaa. uchegavvna tattaa, kol tziyyurin, vechol diukenin dealma kullehu tamman. veal da, avidat mashkena, vaavidat (220 amud alef) shamayim veeretz, kullehu beraza chada.

Ketiv (Yeshayahu 40:26) seu marom enechem ureu mi vara elle vegomer. hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, vechi begin deyistakkal bar nash enoy leella, vezakif lon leella, yachil leminda uleistakkela bema dela itterashu leminda ulemechome.

Ella seu marom enechem, man devae leistakkela uleminda beovadoy dekudesha berich hu, yizkof enoy leella, veyechme kama chayyaylin, vechamma mashiryayn, ovadin meshanyayn da min da, ravrevin illen meillen. ucheden techomun vetishalun vetemrun, man vara illen. mi bara elle, ha okimna raza demi, vara elle. dehu atar dekayyeyma marom veganiz vesatim vela yedia, (92 amud alef, 168 amud bet) vekayyeyma tadir lishela, begin dela itgalyay lehahu atar. (Bereshit 2 amud alef)

Hammotzi bemispar tzevaam, may hammotzi. ella begin dehahu atar deihu tamir veganiz, ihu appik kolla, beraza dekol denafik mishshofar. vehahu kol, ihu mispar dechol chelin illain, vechushebana decholla. umittamman ishtechach raza dimhemnuta illaa, bechol innun sitrin illain, ad denagdin dargin, veitmashshechan letatta, veitparshan kama (140) chelin lezinnayyhu, vechullehu kayyman bechushebana, veikrun bishma. merov onim, da sitra dimina. veammitz koach, da sitra dismala. ish lo nedar, sitrin denagdin mitteren avarin.
961: Davar acher seu marom enechem ureu mi vara elle, hay kera kad ittekam mashkena. vahava ittakkan, kol man dechame leh lemashkena, istakkal beh leella vetatta, vecholla chame beh bemashkena. begin dechol ovadin dealma illaa vetattaa, kullehu ittakanu beh bemashkena, veha okimna, kol man dechame innun kerasim bemashkena, veistakkal behu, hava mistakkal binhiru dilhon, binhiru (229 amud alef) dekochavayya, begin dehachi kayyman kochavaya birkia.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 148:1) haleluyah halelu et Adonai min hashshamayim vegomer, ta chaze tushebachta da amar david, lokovel raza dishma kaddisha, deihu kelala detushebachta decholla. teren tushebchan innun, kegavvna deraza dishma kaddisha illaa, deihu kelala detushebachta decholla. veinnun: da, vetushebachta batraa, deihi kelala detushebachta decholla, dichtiv, (Tehillim 150:1) haleluyah halelu el bekadsho vegomer. aval da hava, al eser minim. veda hu al sheva, vecholla raza chada bishma kaddisha.

Haleluyah halelu et Adonai min hashshamayim, ihu sheruta deshit sitrin leitpashta letatta, deda ihu raza dekayyeyma lishela, kema deat amer, (Devarim 4:32) ki sheal na leyamim rishonim asher hayu lefanecha vegomer, ad hacha it reshu lishela, min hayyom asher bara vegomer, vead ketze hashshamayim mikkan ulehala, lav kayyeyma lishela, begin deihu atar tamir veganiz.

Veal da halelu et Adonai min hashshamayim haleluhu bamromim, illen teren sitrin, (deinnun ruma desheruta) yemina usemala. umehacha itpashshetan kullehu acharanin letatta, beraza dedargin leittakna kedka yeot. haleluhu (166 amud alef) chol malachav, illen teren kayaymin dekayyme techot gufa, lemishan gufa alayyhu.

Ta chaze, innun kayaymin degufa ishtean alayyhu, kayyme hacha beraza demalachin, begin deyarchin innun shelichan, lemezal meatar leatar, umeraza da, nafkin innun deikrun malachin, deinnun shelichan lemehach bishlichuta demarehon, meatar laatar.

Haleluhu kol tzevaav, da ihu atar denafke minneh kol chelin kaddishin illain, raza deat kayyayma kaddisha, veihu rashim bechol shear ribbevavn, kadka amaran, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 48:2) Adonai tzevaot shemo, ot ihu bechol shear chelin verivvavn.

Haleluhu shemesh veyareach, beh kayyeyma raza da, veihu shimsha leanhara, uveh kayymin kochavayay illain denaharin, umazzale, veha okimna. levatar ahdar leella, lehahu atar dekaim beruma dimmeromim, vetamman tekiu decholla, haleluhu sheme hashamayim. levatar halelu et Adonai min haaretz, lokovel illen esh uvarad vegomer.

Ta chaze, innun kochavim letatta, kayymin bimshichu deitmashshechan meraza illaa, begin decholla kayyeyma bediyyukena illaa, veha (Bereshit 34 amud alef) okimna. uvegin kach kol innun kochavayay umazzale, merum rekia, kullehu kayyme leanhaga beh alma diltatta minneh, umittamman itpashshetan dargin, ad dekayymin dargin leinnun kochavayay diltatta, dechullehu la kayyme birshutayyhu kelum, veha okimna, vechullehu kayyeyman birshuta dilella. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 47:13) yaamdu na veyoshiucha hovre shamayim hachozim bakkochavim, vecholla ihu birshuta veittemar.

(Shemot 39:28) vayyaasu et hakkatnot shesh vegomer veet hammitznefet shesh vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Yeshayahu 2:2) vehaya beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet Adonai berosh heharim vegomer. vehaya beacharit hayyamim, kad yifkod lah kudesha berich hu livrata deyaakov, veyokim lah meafra, veyitchabbar shimsha besihara, keden nachon yihye har bet Adonai, da yerushala 40 leella, dittehe mittakkena betikkunaha leitnahara binhora dilella, dechol nehoraha lav ihu mittakkena, ella binhora dilella. uvehahu zimna yitnehir ala nehora illaa, al chad shiva mimma dahavat mikkadmat dena, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim vegomer.
Berosh heharim. berashe heharim mibbae leh. may berosh ella nehora da diyhe lah
962: Berosh heharim ihu. uman ihu rosh heharim. da kahana rabba. deihu rosh heharim. resha decholla setar yemina. veda ihu dimtakken leveta tadir, umevarech lah leanhara anpaha. veal da, yihye nachon.

Uvemma yetakken lah. beinnun levushin deinnun kegavvna dilella, kema deukemuha. veinnun levushin kullehu kayyman beraza deshit. vehay beta kad yehe mittakkan behay rosh heharim, deihu kahana rabba, keden itkashshar veistallak leella bekiyyuma illaa, veyitnehir alma mehahu nehiru illaa, (keden) veda hu venissa miggevaot, mikkol shear chelin umashiryayn illain, ucheden venaharu elav kol haggoyim.

Ta chaze, beshaata dechahana diltatta paris yedoy, keden rucha illaa anhir, venafik, vechol butzinin naharin, unehorin itmashshechan veitnaharan veitkashsheran illen beillen, ad deyitnehiru anpaha dichneset yisrael, vecholla al yeda dinhora kadmaa deihu kahana. vechad kahana atar letatta, kahana ittear leella. uveovadin diltatta, atar ittearuta dilella.

Veal da nachon yihye har bet Adonai berosh heharim vegomer, venaharu elav kol haggoyim. begin dehashta, kol shear ammin, it lon memanan birkia alayyhu. uvehahu zimna, yevaer lon, veyappil lon kudesha berich hu mishshuletanihon, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 24:21) yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom, vechevan dechullehu yitabberun mishshuletanehon, keden kudesha berich hu yittakaf bilchodeh, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 2:2) venisgav Adonai levaddo bayom hahu, ucheden venaharu elav kol haggoyim. vehada hu dichtiv, vehalchu ammim rabbim veamru lechu venaale el har Adonai el bet elohe yaakov vegomer.
Vecholla ihu, beshaata dechahana, deihu rosh heharim yanhir lah, vecholla ihu beraza deshesh, shit innun bechol sitrin deyanhir lah, deha beraza deshit yanhir lah.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havo azle beorcha, amar ribbi elazar, iddan ihu lemehach bishchinta, begin dishchinta la tishre alan, ella miggo mille deorayyta. amar ribbi yehuda, man deihu risha, liftach beresha.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Tehillim 119:141) tzair anochi venivze pikkudecha lo shachachti. tzair anochi venivze, david malka, lezimnin ihu ka meshabbach garmeh, dichtiv, (Tehillim 18:51) veose chesed limshicho ledavid ulezaro ad olam. uchetiv, (Shmuel 2 23:1) neum david ben yishay uneum haggever hukam al meshiach elohe yaakov. ulezimnin aved garmeh miskena, dichtiv, (Tehillim 86:1) ki ani veevyon ani. uchetiv tzair anochi venivze. veihu amar (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pinna.

Ella, bezimna dehava salik bedarga dishlama, veistallak bedina dikshot, vahava shallit al sanoy, hava ka meshabbach garmeh. uvezimna dechama garmeh beaku, veshanoy ka dachakin leh, keden maich garmeh, vahava kare garmeh miskena, zeira lecholla. may taama. begin, deha lezimnin hava shallit, ulezimnin hava beaku desanoy.

Veim kol da ihu shallit alayyhu tadir, vela yachilu leh. vedavid malka, tadir ihu hava shafil garmeh legabbe kudesha berich hu, dechol man demaich garmeh kame kudesha berich hu, ihu zakif leh al kolla. uvegin kach, itree beh kudesha berich hu behay alma, uvealma deate. bealma den, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 37:35) vegannoti al hair hazzot lehoshiah lemaani ulemaan david avdi. uvealma deate, dichtiv, (Hoshea 3:Adonai) uvikshu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam ufachadu el Adonai veel tuvo beacharit hayyamim. david ihu hava malka behay alma, vedavid yehe malka lezimna deate. veal da amar, even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pina.

Ta chaze, beshaata deshimsha mehadder anpoy, vela nahir lesihara, itabbar nehoraha (lesihara) vela nehirat, keden ihi bemiskenuta bechol sitrin, veitkadderat. velet lah nehora kelal. vechad shimsha ahdar lokovlah, veanhir lah, keden itnehirat anpaha, veitkashshetat legabbeh, kenukeba deitkashshetat legabbe dechura, ucheden ihi shalta
963: Veal da, david hava meatter garmeh, behahu gavvna mammash. lezimnin ihu miskena, ulezimnin ihu beutera beattiru decholla, uvegin kach hava amar, tzair anochi venivze. veim kol da, pikkudecha lo shachachti. kegavvna da, it leh lebar nash lemeheve nivze beenav, (sefer acher venavoza uma i david malka kach kol shekken bar nash achara deit leh) leashpela garmah becholla, lemeheve ihu mana dekudesha berich hu itree beh, veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:15) veet dakka ushefal ruach. hasheta ana eftach beresha.

Patach veamar, (Yechezkel 40:3) vayyave oti shamma vehinne ish marehu kemare nechoshet ufetil pishtim beyado ukene hammidda vehu omed bashaar. hay chama leh yechezkel, behahu chezu dinvua, vehay ihu ish, deihu shelicha beinnun levushin.

Vehacha la amar ella ish, vela amar ish levush habbaddim. ella, beshaata deavid shelichuta lemebad dina, o leachazaa dina, ikre levush habbaddim. uveshaata dela ate lehachi, ishtanne legavvna achara, kefum shelichuta, hachi shane chezu dileh beinnun levushin, veishtane milvushin lilvushin, begin deihu tadir bistar semala, vechamma gavvnin innun deitlavash behu, vechol innun deatyayn missitreh.

Marehu kemare nechoshet, hacha itlabbash behahu levusha deinnun (260 amud alef, 139 amud alef, 229 amud alef) ture nechoshet, deikrun (Zecharya 6) hare nechoshet. veda ayyte medidu, lemebad mishchata.

Hay (155 hammidda) lav ihu butzina dekardinuta detamir veganiz, ella mittamman nafkat hay kane letatta, deitgelid miggo nehiru deishtevik mibbutzina dekardinuta, kad istalakat leella, veitgelafat go (245 amud bet) sefiru denatzitz vela ityeyda. veal da, hahu kene hammidda ihu kayyeyma bimdidu demishchata, dekayyeyma letatta.

Ulezimnin kene hammidda, ulezimnin (258 amud alef) kav hamidda, veal da petil vekane, vecholla mishchata lemebad medidu, (hatam) kol medidu diychezkel, ihu hava behahu kene hammidda, uveovada demashkena kolla hava bekav hamidda.

Bemashkena, behahu medidu diltatta, deihu kav hamidda, kegavvna dehahu petil, dechad share leitpashsheta, bechol amma chad kishra, uvehahu mishchata medid, veikre amma. uvegin kach, shemone veesrim baamma, deda hu arka vefuteya arba baamma, vela ketiv arba ammot, begin deama medid lechol setar.

Vehay nafka, meraza devutzina dilella, dimdidu dehay letatta mehay medidu dilella ishtechach. medidu diltatta, elef vachamesh mea sitrin, vechol sitra vesitra teresar alfe ammin, veal da amma chad azil bechullehu, vehahu amma dimdid da, itpeshat kav mishchata veitgalyay amma umedid, vechen bechol innun mishchate. (sefer acher teresar alfe ammin itpashat kav meshachta vaatagelayya amma vamedayd vechen bechol inun mashechatey veal amma chad azil bechullehu vehahu amma damedayd da madid da).

Shemone veesrim baamma, ihu arka, dechad amma, ufuteye arba behahu amma. ishtechach, amma chad deihu telatin uteren shelishim. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 40:12) vechol bashshalish afar haaretz, veinnun 32, lokovel 32 shevilin denafkin milella.

Vechad itavid mishchata dearka behay medidu, ihu arba sitrin hahu arka. vechol sitra 7 ammin, dilhachi salkan innun shiva ammin, learba sitrin, beraza desheva, (sefer acher vametachevameyn) deinnun temanya veesrim deinnun bearka, begin desheva ihu raza illaa becholla. vechol innun telatin uteren shevilin kelilan besheva, beraza dishma kaddisha.

Vei tema, ha ketiv midda achat lechol hayeriot. vadday midda achat ihu, af al gav deitpashshat amma batar amma, veda batar da, vecholla beraza (sefer acher meraza) devutzina dilella ka atya, lemeheve ella vetatta mishchata chada.

Veda ihu mishchata deihu bikdushsha yattir, begin deit mishchata achara, deihi lechafya al da deihi lego. deha bemishchata achara dechafyya al da, salleka bechushebana bechusheban 34, ulegav bechusheban 32 (sefer acher deihi dechafya al da deihi lego vesalleka bechushebana, bechusheban 34 valegaav bechusheban 32) veda ihu raza
964: Dechafya da al da, 32 lego, 34 (32 ihu kayyeyma lego, 34 ihu kayyeyma) levar.

Begin deha mishchata kadmaa, deihu kaddisha bigvavnin kaddishin, deinnun shesh mashzar utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani, illen gavvnin kaddishin, vechol chusheban dileh salleka lechusheban 32. umishchata tinyayna deihu levar lechafyay al da, ihi salleka lechusheban 34. veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. beyom raa mammash, yemalletehu Adonai.

Raza dechushebana lego, deihu raza 32. uvehahu chushebana dilvar, ma ketiv, veasita yeriot izzim. yeriot izzim, amay izzim. ella raza degavvna dileh, lemehav ducheta beraza dekudesha, uvegin kach yeriot izzim vadday. ketiv (Shir HaShirim 6:11) el ginnat egoz yaradti vegomer, ha ukemuha, aval ma egoz it leh kelifa, desachara vechafyay al mocha, umocha lego, uf hachi bechol milla dekudesha, kedushsha lego, vesitra achara levar. veraza da, (Chavakuk 1:4) rasha machtir et hatztzadik. veal da ikre egoz, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, behahu dilvar, kol ma deosif gara, vesimanich pare hechag, demitmaatin veazlin. uf hacha name, bema dilgav (164 amud bet) ketiv, veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot. bema dilvar ketiv, ashte esre yeriot. osif atvavn vegara mechushebana. osif chushebana vegara (atvavn), osif chushebana, dichtiv, (Shemot 26:8) orech hayeria haachat sheloshim baamma verochav arba baamma hayeria. vechad salik lechushebna, salik lechusheban dal. delet bechol innun zine miskenuta, kehahu deikre dal, uvegin kach kad salik lechushebna yattir, salik bigriu.

Vechad ihu gara bechushebana (gara), salik bisliku, desalik leraza delv, deihu raza dechol mehemnuta, veihu raza dishma kaddisha, veal da, da salik, veda gara. da salik vegara. veda gara vesalik. da lego. veda levar.

Hay kav hamidda, share leitpashta, umedid mishchata lakkerashim, dichtiv (Shemot 36:20) vayyaas et hakkerashim lamishkan atze shittim omdim, veillen innun raza disrafim, veha ukemuha, dichtiv atze shittim omdim, uchetiv (Yeshayahu 6:2) serafim omdim.

Medidu demishchata da, eser ammot orech hakkaresh veamma vachatzi haamma. hacha ketiv eser ammot, vela ketiv eser baamma. illen telat telat telat, deinnun tesha, vechad desharya alayyhu, veda ihu rucha chada desharya alayyhu.

Veha amaran, kama ihu shiura deamma. veda ihu raza deshiura chad sere ufalga, desallekin, vela sallekin, begin degarin meinnun ofannim. veukemuha beraza dirticha kaddisha, veinnun esrin, lehay sitra eser, ulehay sitra eser, ad desallekin leraza disrafim illain. ulevatar salik raza dekudesha, ad deattearu (sefer acher daataadav) kullehu, beraza dehahu bariach hattichon, kema deukemuha, veal da pelag it beh bela shelimu.
Raza dehay mishchata, leesrin dappin innun matan utelatin. vechol hay kayyeyma bimdidu bechushebana, vehachi salik kol chusheban denafka mehay medidu beraza deinnun serafim.

Yeriot demashkena deamaran deinnun razin illain. raza dishmayya veha ukemuha (Tehillim 104:2) note shamayim kayria. veraza dehay behahu chusheban dekaamaran. veit yerian dekaamaran beraza chada veit yerian beraza achara, vecholla ihu beraza dilella. veal da kolla ihu leminda chachmeta, dechol sitra vesitra, vechol milla umilla. veal da avchin bar nash ben tav levish, ben raza dechachmeta, uven milla dela kayyeyma bechachmeta. uveraza dimdidu kadmaa, ha ittemar bechamma sitrin ihu.
Raza da raza daarona dekaim bechushebana, mimma deihu natil, umimma deihu kabbil, umimma deit beh, umimma ihu mekabbel: deihu teren sitrin, venatil meinnun
965: Teren sitrin. veal da amma ihu besitra da, veama besitra da, ufalga dileh. uvegin kach amatayim vachetzi arko, amatayim mitteren sitrin, ufalga dileh, hay bearka. befuteya veruma, amma vachetzi, chad mehahu sitra yattir, deka natil kegavvna dimina usemala. ufalga dileh. deha la sharya milla, ella al milla uvegin kach, palga bechol chusheban vechusheban, uvegin kach, arona mekabbela mikkolla, vekayyeyma beraza dechushebana decholla.
Veha ukemuha, al ma ihu mechafyay bedahava, lego ulevar, vehay ihu shiura lemekam bimdidu kadmaa, vecholla kaim beraza chada. pattora, kehay gavvna demadid behahu shiura kadmaa.

Aval hay medidu daarona, dekayyeyma beraza deorayyta, uvehahu mishchata kadmaa dekaamar abba, let bah lemebad shiura yattir kema deihu galle beraza lechakkime elyonin, leminda bah raza dechachmeta, leavchana ben tav levish, ben chachmeta illaa, lechachmeta achara. kullehu ovadin acharanin, kullehu bimdidu deamma, behahu mishchata, bar mishchata dechoshen, deihu zeret, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, ketonet (af al gav) dechullehu itavidu beraza dikdushsha, kolla ihu beraza deshesh, uveovada deshesh, vekayyeyma beshesh. vechullehu tikkunin, leitlabbesha uleatkena behu shesh, uveraza deshesh.

Vecholla beraza dekav hamidda. ukene hammidda behahu medidu diychezkel, begin deihu beta leitkayyeyma (nusach acher begin da hahu beta lo aytakeyymaa) beatreh, beinnun kotalin, beinnun shurin, beinnun pitchin, beinnun delatin, begin lemeheve kolla bimdidu. aval lezimna deate, mishchata hahu ma ketiv bah, (Yechezkel 41:7) verachava venasva lemala lemala. beshaata deyishre lemivne beh hay kene hammidda, salleka leella leella, learka ulefuteya, lemeheve itpashshetuta deveta bechol sitrin vela yishgechun aleh levish, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Zecharya 9:1) vedammesek menuchato. deha behahu zimna dina la yishtechach bealma, begin kach kolla itkeyyaym al kiyyumeh bekiyyuma shelim, kema deat amer (Shmuel 2 7:10) lo yirgaz od velo yosifu vene avla leannoto vegomer.

Veta chaze, kol mishchatin, vechol medidin, kullehu kayymin behay alma, (sefer acher vechol madeydeyn dehay mashkena vehay beta kullehu) begin leitkayyeyma hay alma, beraza degavvna dilella, leitkashshera hay alma bealma dilella, lemeheve kolla chad beraza chada. uvehahu zimna dekudesha berich hu ittear lechaddetute alma, keden yishtakkechun kullehu almin beraza chada, vikara dekudesha berich hu becholla, ucheden ketiv, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Patach ribbi yehuda avatrih veamar, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam. hay kera ha ukemuha, aval sod Adonai liyiriav, hahu raza illaa dekayyeyma bignizu, (deihu satim veganiz) la kayyeyma ella lireav, deinnun dachalin lekudesha berich hu tadir, veinnun itchazun leinnun razin illain, ulemehve innun razin illain bignizu uvistimu kedka yeot, begin deinnun razin illain. aval uverito lehodiam, raza deihu kayyeyma bivrit kayyayma, lehodiam, begin deihu atar dekayyeyma legallaa leminda.

Tu sod Adonai lireav, deinnun razin dekayyman bidchilu, veinnun dachale chattaa dachalin behu, beinnun razin illain. aval uverito lehodiam: leminda ulefarsha millin, begin deinnun millin dekayyman lefarsha.

Ta chaze, bearbein uteren atvavn itgelif alma, veitkayyaym. vechullehu atara dishma kaddisha. kad mitztarfin, (Bereshit 30 amud bet) sallekin beatvoy leella, venachtin letatta, mitatteran itrin, bearba sitre alma, veyachil leitkayyeyma.
Ulevatar nafku atvavn uvaru alma leella vetatta. bealma deyichuda, uvealma deferuda, veitkerun hare vater, ture (Bereshit 240 amud bet) defiruda demishtakyayn. kad sitra dedarom shari lekarva
966: Bahadeh, ucheden mayya nagdin, uvechela da deella, nagid, kolla hu bechedu.
Kad machashava, salik biru dechedva, mittemira dechol temirin, mate venagid miggaveh chad zihara, mitkarvin da beda, veha ukemuha.

Veinnun arbein uteren atvavn, innun raza illaa, uveinnun itbere alma illaa vealma tattaa. veinnun kiuma veraza dechol almin. veal deihu raza dealmin, ketiv sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam. da raza, deatvavn gelifin, begilafoy beitgalyay.

Ketiv venatatta el choshen hammishpat et haurim veet hattummim, veha ukemuha. et haurim: denaharin, raza deasfakalarya denahara, veda ihu gelifu deatvavn dishma kaddisha, beraza dearbein uteren, divhu itberun almin, vahavu meshukkain beh. veet hattummim: raza deinnun atvavn, dichlilan baatar deasfakalarya dela nahara. veihi (132 amud alef) itnahaga (davar acher itnahara) bev atvavn gelifin, deinnun raza dishma kadisha, vechullehu ikrun urim vetumim.

Ta chaze, kad innun atvavn meshukaaan tamman, behahu chela, naharin atvavn acharanin, biglifu deinnun shemahan dishvatin, venaharin o itchashchan, vecholla behahu raza deinnun atvavn dishmahan kaddishin kidkamran. veinnun atvavn dishmahan kaddishin, innun atyayn al raza deorayyta, vechullehu almin atvavn (sefer acher atebarevan), beraza deillen atvavn. illen shemahan havo genizin meshukkain tamman, ushemahan dishvatin havo baltin atvavn dilhon leella. veal da kolla meraza deinnun atvavn, vecholla okimna.

Veha ittemar beraza deatvavn deorayyta. 2, deorayyta sharat ba, veha ukemuha 2 bara vadday bechela illaa, bitkifu deraza deinnun atvavn. 2 nukeba, 1 dechura. kema dev bara, hachi name 1, appik atvavn, kelala deesrin uteren atvavn.

Adonai, ziuuga chada bashamayim, lemehav leh chayyin, uleashraa leh. 6, haaretz, lemehav lah mezona, uleatkena lah sippuka deitchaze lah. veraza da bereshit vegomer, ad hashshamayim veet haaretz. 6 veet, kelala deesrin uteren atvavn, umittezan ara, veara kalil lon legavvav kema deat amer, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam, vehayeynu raza, veet haaretz, dechanish lecholla begavvav, vekabbilat lon. haaretz natlat 6, vekabbilat lon leattezana.

Veraza da, mashkena la attekan ella al yeda demoshe, begin demehahu sitra, atar darga achara illaa, lekayyeyma leh, lemeheve kiuma decholla. veraza da, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan, kiuma dileh hava, beinnun atvavn deitberiu behu shemaya veara.

Uvegin kach, kol avidan demashkena, hava betzalel avid lon, beraza degillufa (datzeravepaa) deatvavn, deitberiu behon shemaya veara. veal da ikre betzalel, begin dehava yada betzalel, gillufa (tzerufa) deatvavn, deitberiu behu shemaya veara. vei la dehava yada lehu betzalel, la hava yachil lemebad ihu innun avidan demashkena. may taama. ella, kema demashkena illaa, la hava vela atkinu kol ovadoy, ella behahu raza deinnun atvavn, uf hacha mashkena diltatta, la hava vela ittakkan, ella berazin deinnun atvavn.

Betzalel hava metzaref innun atvavn, uveraza dechol tzerufa vetzerufa hava avid umanuta. vechol avida vaavida demashkena, bechol tzerufa hava avid chad umanu, vechol ma deitchaze leh. vechen bechol avidan demashkena, vechol innun shayyfin vetikkunin demashkena, kolla hava betzerufa deatvavn dishma kaddisha.
Vechad ata leakama leh, la hava yachil lemekam leh. may tama. begin diruta desalik al innun atvavn, la itmesar ella lemoshe bilchodoy, veihu hava yada hahu reuta desalik leinnun atvavn, veal da
967: Ittekam mashkena al yedeh, dichtiv vayyakem moshe. vayitten moshe. vayyasem moshe. uvetzalel la hava yada, vela hava yachil lemekam leh.

Patach ribbi yitzchak avatreh veamar, (Tehillim 21:5) Adonai beazzecha yismach melech uvishuatcha ma yagel meod taavat libbo vegomer, chayyim shaal mimmecha vegomer, shirata da la amar lah david, ella al tushebachta dichneset yisrael, dekudesha berich hu chadde lah bechedu deorayyta, deikre oz, dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:11) Adonai oz leammo yitten vegomer. yismach melech: da kudesha berich hu (davar acher da keneset yisrael) deitkere melech, dichtiv, (Devarim 33:5) vayhi vishurun melech.

Uvishuatcha ma yagel meod, da (223 amud alef) yeshua dimina, kema deat amer (Tehillim 60:7) hoshia yemincha vaaneni. vattosha lo yemino. ma (davar achar) yagel meod, 10 yetera, veda ihu raza divrit kayyayma kaddisha, deihu chedva decholla (dilah), vecholla al hay melech ittemar.

Chayyim shaal mimmecha natatta lo orech yamim olam vaed. mehacha olifna, dedavid malka la havo leh chayyim kelal, bar deadam kadmaa yahav leh midileh. veha ukemuha, dedavid demalka itkayyaym shivin shenin. veinnun 70 shenin yahiv leh kudesha berich hu meinnun shenin deadam kadmaa, uvehu itkayyaym, veityeyhiv leh orichu deyomin behay alma, uvealma deate, veal da chayyim shaal mimmecha natatta lo.

Gadol kevodo, begin deihu gadol, dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:5) gadol adonenu verav koach. vadday ikre gadol, veraza da, (Bereshit 1:7) vayyaas elohim et shene hammeorot haggedolim, gedolim havo vadday. veim kol da, ihu ikre gadol, kema deittemar gadol adonenu verav koach. vekudesha berich hu la ikre gadol, ella behay, dichtiv, (Tehillim 48:2) gadol Adonai umehullal meod beir elohenu har kadsho. bema ihu gadol, (Vayikra Adonai amud alef) beir elohenu har kadsho.

(Tehillim 21:7) ki teshitehu verachot laad. ki teshitehu verachot, begin dehay ihu birchata dechol alma, vechol birchan dechol alma mehacha nafke, veda ihu beracha. veraza da, (Bereshit 12) vehye beracha. deha hacha sherian kol birchan dilella, umehacha nafke lechol alma, veal da ikre beracha.

Techadehu besimcha, ketiv hacha techadehu besimcha, uchetiv hatam (Shemot 18:9) vayyichadd yitro, begin dezammin kudesha berich hu leakkama lah likkenset yisrael meafra, uleattekfa bah beraza dimina, ulechaddetote lah chadtuta desihara beshimsha.

Ketiv techaddehu besimcha et panecha, et panecha, lemeheve kammach, ulemeheve bechedu lokovel anpach, behahu shelimu detishtelim behahu zimna. deha bezimna deitcharav be makdesha, itrekinat mikkol ma deitmalleyay. kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 15:9) umlela yoledet hashshiva. uchetiv (Yechezkel 26:2) immala hochorava. (kan chaser)

Ta chaze, behahu zimna deokim moshe yat mashkena, istakkal bechol innun avidan, dahavo kedka yeot, ucheden okim leh. vechol innun avidan dahavo beh bemashkena, kol chad vechad ayytiu leh lemoshe. veraza da (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha reoteha muvaot lach. muvaot lach dichtiv. (Shemot 39:33) vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe.

Amay vayyaviu et hammishkan. begin deha behahi shaata, hava ziuuga demoshe leizdavvevga, veal da vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe, kema deayyte kalla leve chatan. begin deha bekadmita itzterich leaala lechalla legabbe chatan, kema deat amer (Devarim 22:16) et bitti natatti laish hazze leisha. ulevatar ihu (238 amud alef) yete legabbah, dichtiv vayyavo eleha. uchetiv (Bamidbar 17:23) vayyavo moshe el ohel haedut.

Vehacha ma ketiv, velo yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed ki shachan alav heanan vegomer. may taama. begin dahavat ihi mittatkena, kehay itteta deittaknat veitkashshetat legabbe balah, uvehahi shaata deihi ka mitkashshetat, la itchaze levalah leaala legabbah. veal da velo yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed ki shachan alav heanan begin kach vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe. od ma ketiv vayyar moshe et kol hammelacha vegomer.
968: Ta chaze, bechol avidan demashkena, bechullehu hava gavvna detichla. begin detichla ihu gavvna leitattera beraza dechol gavvnin. ma ketiv vayyaasu et tzitz nezer hakkodesh vegomer, vayyittenu alav petil techelet vegomer, veha ukemuha, beraza dichtiv, (Shemot 28:36) veasita tzitz zahav tahor ufittachta alav pittuche chotam kodesh laAdonai. vayyichtevu alav michtav pittuche chotam kodesh laAdonai.

Tosefta berazin ilain. taskure kemitin shechichin illen salkin venachatin veillen kayymin bekiyyumayyhu galgallin desacharan havu kayyman mehahu zimna deafra itkannish. inun galgallin sacharin alma besacharanutta.

Sacharanuta desacharin midbarin, tifsera dekuleta begavvavyyhu. chad galgalla it begavavyyhu, hay galgalla sachara vela sachara. kayyeyma bitresar alfe almin. benayyhu shechiach, salik venatil begavavyyhu.

Techot hahu galgalla, kayyeyma chad ammuda denaitz ad tehoma rabba. beh, mitgalgelan avanin go tehome, innun sallekin venachtin. hahu ammuda kaim alayyhu, natil vela natil, naitz meella letatta, sacharan matan veesrin galgallin acharanin, sacharaneh dehahu ammuda.

Hahu galgalla achara dealeh, dekaim bitresar alfe alma, ihu sachara go mashkena, sachara vela sachara. hahu mashkena kaim al teresar alfe almin, beh kayyeyma hahu karoza, dekare istamaru (220 amud bet) megalgala desachara.

Man deihu mare deayynin besachletanu, yinda veyistakkal bechachmeta demareh, veyinda deinnun millin illain, demaftechan demareh kayyman tamman, di innun temiran go mashkena kaddisha. zakkain innun behay alma, vezakkain innun bealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Tehillim 84:6) ashre adam oz lo vach mesillot bilvavam. (Tehillim 65:5) ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha nisbea betuv betecha kedosh hechalecha. (ad kan tosefta)

Beraza demashkena kayyman razin illain, beraza dishma kaddisha (illaa) adonay, hay ihu raza demashkena, kegavvna raza illaa, raza daarona, kema dichtiv, (Yehoshua 3:11) hinne aron habberit adon kol haaretz. adon kol haaretz, da hu raza kaddisha dishma dealef dalet nun yod. veda hu kegavvna deraza dishma kaddisha illaa Adonai. veatvavn illen kegavvna deillen.

1 Ihi 10, raza deyod (nusach acher da) kegavvna da 1, veha ukemuha. 4, ihu raza Adonai, veda kegavvna deda, vecholla kegavvna veraza chada. (Vayikra 155 amud alef) 50, ihi raza deat 6, veaf al gav deda dechar, veda (180 amud bet) nukeba. aval da itkelil beda, veha ukemuha 50 6 (183 amud bet) ihu beemtzaita, begin deihu kelala chada. Adonai ihu raza deat 10 (nusach acher 10 ihi raza deat Adonai), begin dehacha (nusach acher 9), da ihi chachma zeera, deikre chachmat shelomo.

Veitkelilu atvavn illen beillen, vecholla ihi raza chada, kelilan illen beillen, vecholla chad, vecholla ihu raza chada, beatvavn kaddishin. veal da mashkena diltatta beara, kayyeyma beraza demashkena illaa, vehahu mashkena illaa, kayyeyma beraza demashkena achara illaa al kolla. vecholla ihu kalil da beda lemehve chad, veal da ketiv, vehaya hammishkan echad.

Ketiv (Bamidbar 24:20) reshit goyim amalek veacharito ade oved. ta chaze, beyoma deitkam mashkena, deakim leh moshe, kema deittemar, dichtiv vayyakem moshe et hammishkan, dela hava yachil lemekam, ad deokim leh ihu. lematronita, delet reshu levar nash achara lemekam lah ella balah. uf hachi, kol innun umanin, kullehu ate leakama mashkena, vela yachil lemekam al yedayyhu, ad deata moshe, veokim leh, begin deihu (Bereshit nusach acher amud bet) marih deveta.

Kevan deakim moshe yat mashkena letatta, ittekam mashkena achara leella, kema deukemuha, dichtiv hukam, vela parish al yeda deman, (ella) dela ittekam ella meraza dealma illaa, deihu satim veganiz, al yeda deraza demoshe, begin leittakna bahadeh.
Ma ketiv leella, vayyavou kol hachachamim haosim
969: Et kol melechet hakkodesh vegomer, man innun chachamim haosim. illen innun yemina usemala, vechol shear sitrin, deinnun orchin ushevilin leaala go yamma, ulemalya leh, veinnun avdu mashkena leella, veatkinu leh.

Kegavvna da letatta, veasa betzalel veoholiav, da bistar yemina, veda bistar semala, (220 amud bet) betzalel limina, veoholiav lismala, da mihuda, veda middan, ulevatar vechol ish chacham lev, vayavou kol hachachamim haosim, veha okimna, vecholla kegavvna dilella.

Behahu yoma deittekam mashkena, itbatal mota mealma. itbatal la tema, ella istallak mealma, dela yachil leshalletaa. kema deokimna. begin dela yitbetal yetzer hara mealma, ad deyete malka meshicha, vekudesha berich hu yachde beovadoy ucheden (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach. kad ittekam mashkena al yede demoshe, keden itperashat chela deyetzer hara, veitkafya, vela hava yachil leshalletaa. behahi shaata, itperash samael, takkifa rugeza dismala, meal tukepa dechivya bisha, vela yachil leshalta al alma, vela yachil leitchabbera beh bevar nash, ulemiste leh.

Ribbi yehuda amar, kad avdu yisrael yat egla, ma ketiv (Shemot 33:7) umoshe (Bereshit 52 amud bet) yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane. may taama. begin dechama yetzer hara dehava azil benayyhu. amar moshe, sitra dikdushsha la tishre bego sitra dimsaava. ribbi elazar amar, kol zimna desitra dikdushsha shalta, sitra mesaava la yachil leshalletaa, veitkafya kammeh. veal da tanenan, kol zimna diyrushalam tihye melea, tzur chayyayva yehe chareva.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 24:65) vattomer el haeved mi haish hallaze haholech bassade likratenu vayyomer haeved vegomer. ma ketiv leella, vattissa rivka et eneha vattere et yitzchak vattippol meal haggamal. hay kera amay itzterich lemichtav beorayyta. vetu, vechi begin dechamat shefiru deyitzchak (may tama) itrekinat miggamla.

Ella, hay kera raza ihu. ta chaze, (vattere et yitzchak mena yedaa deihu yitzchak, ella vattere et yitzchak chamat behahi shaata ma dela yadata) (sefer acher beshaata dametaat rivka legabbe deyitzchak, shaata ditzlota demincha havat, uvehahu zimna dina ittear bealma), vechamat leh berugeza dedina kashya, vechamat deha siyyum derugeza kashya ihu gamal letatta, veda ihu raza demota, uvegin kach itrekinat veashmitat garmah mehahu gamal. deha kad istakkal dina kashya, hahu gamal ittakkaf. uvegin kach ashmitat garmah minne, vela yatvat tamman. (sefer acher raza demota vechad hay dina kashya ittear hahu gamal ittakkaf uvegin kach aterakenat vaashameytet garmah mehahu gamal)

Ta chaze, hay gamal, hayeynu raza dichtiv, (Mishlei 19:17) ugemulo yeshallem lo, da gemul deinnun chayyayvayya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:11) oy lerasha ra ki gemul yadav yease lo. vehay ihu gamal, dekayyeyma leachla kolla, uleshetzaa kolla. vehay ihu zammin tadir lokovel (nusach acher lekatla nusach acher lechabbala) bene nasha. uvegin kach (248 amud bet emor 106 amud bet) hay man dechame bechelmeh gamal, achmiu leh mota deitgezarat aleh, veishteziv minneh.

Ta chaze, hay sitra dimsaava ikre hachi, degarim mita lechol alma, vehay hava deaste leadam uleitteteh, vehahu derachiv aleh ihu samael, veihu ata lemite alma, vegaram mota lecholla. uvegin kach ata veshalit al kolla. adam ihu amshich leh legabbeh, vechevan deihu amshich leh legabbeh, keden ihu itmeshach avatrayyhu, ad deaste lon. uvegin kach amar shelomo, (Mishlei Adonai:8) veal tikrav el petach beta, dechol man deitkeriv levetah, keden ihi nafkat umitkashsherat veitmashshechat avatreh.

Veal da rivka, kad chamat dehava leh leitdabbeka besitra dedina kashya. kevan dechamat leh leyitzchak beraza dedina kashya, vechamat demehahu sitra nafak dina achara takkifa, mizzohama dedahava, kad chamat hay, miyyad vattippol meal haggamal, begin leitrafuye min dina mehahu zuhama. ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:6) kol Adonai meshallem gemul leoyvav, mehahu zuhama.
970: Kad avdu yisrael hahu ovada, vegarmu lehahu chova, may taama egel, vela sitra achara. vei tema, deinnun beriru egla, lav hachi. ella innun amru, (Shemot 32:1) kum ase lanu elohim asher yelchu lefanenu, veaharon reuteh hava leakeva lon.

Ella vadday avidta itavid kadka chaze, deha missitra dedahava, nafka susefita, kad itberir dahava, umittamman mitpashshete kol innun sitre semala, deinnun hittucha dehahu (24 amud bet) susefita dedahava, umitparshan lechamma sitrin. vechol innun deit lon chezu sumaka, gon dedahava kayyma beture, kad shimsha betukepeh, begin detukepa deshimsha achze dahava, veolid leh beara. vehahu dimmana behahu tukepa deshimsha, chezu dileh keegla, veikri (Tehillim 91:6) ketev yashud tzohorayim, veda nafka miggo egla hittucha sumaka dedahava, vechol hane atyayn mehahu sitra sumaka, ruach mesaava, dechol innun demitparshe meruach misava mitpashshete bealma.

Vehay ruach misava, ihu chivya bisha. (vaychi 225 amud alef) veit man derachiv aleh, veinnun dechar venukeba. veikrun elle, deinnun mizdammenin bealma, bechol innun sitrin dilhon. veruach kudesha ikre zot, deihi raza divrit, reshima kaddisha deishtechach tadir immeh debar nash. vechen (yeshaya ko) ze Adonai, (Shemot 15) ze eli, aval illen ikrun elle, veal da ketiv, elle elohecha yisrael. uvegin kach ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:15) gam (221 amud alef) elle tishkachna. veanochi raza dezot, lo eshkachech. uchetiv (Eicha 1:16) al elle ani vochiyya, dehahu chova garim lemivke lon kama bichyayn.

Davar acher al elle ani vochiyya. may tama. begin deityeyhiv reshu laatar da leshalletaa al yisrael, ulecharba be makdesha. uvegin deityeyhiv lon reshu leshalletaa, ketiv al elle ani vochiyya, raza demilla al elle da sitra dimsaava deityeyhiv lon reshu leshalletaa. ani vochiyya da ruach kudesha deikre ani.

Vei tema, ha ketiv (Devarim 28:69) elle divre habberit. hachi hu vadday, dechol innun la mitkayyeymin, ella miggo elle, detamman kol levavtin kema deokimna deihu arur, dichtiv (Bereshit 3:14) arur atta mikkol habbehema. uvegin kach, akdim veamar elle, dekayyeyma leman deavar divre habberit. (Vayikra 27:34) elle hammitzvot asher tzivva Adonai et moshe, begin defikkudayya deorayyta leitdakkea bar nash, vela yiste leorcha da, veyistamar mittamman, veyitperash minnayyhu.
Vei tema (Bereshit 6:9) elle toldot noach noach. hachi hu vadday, deha nafak cham, deihu avi kenaan, (Bereshit 9:25) uchetiv arur kenaan, veihu raza da deelle.
Veal da kol hani hittucha susefita dedahava. veaharon kariv dahava, deihu sitra (achara) dileh, dechalil ihu betukefa deeshsha, vecholla chad, vesitra da dahava vaeshsha.

Veruach misaava deishtechach tadir bemadbera, ashkach atar behahu zimna leittatkefa beh. uma dahavo yisrael dachyayn, mehahu zuhama kadmaa, deatil bealma, vegarim mota lecholla, kad kayymu al tura desinay, garam lon kemillekaddemin, lesaava lon, uleittatkefa alayyhu, vegarim lon mota, ulechol alma, uledarehon batrehon, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 82:6) ani amarti elohim attem vegomer. achen keadam temutun vegomer. (ad kan) uvegin kach, aharon ahdar levatar leitdakkea, beraza dimhemnuta illaa, beinnun shiva yomin kaddishin, ulevatar leitdakkea beegla.

Veta chaze, becholla baa aharon leitdakkea, deillu ihu la hava, la nafak egla. may tama. begin deaharon ihu (281 amud alef) yemina. veihu tukepa deshimsha, vedahava mishimsha. ruach misaava nachat, veitkelil tamman, veisteavu yisrael, veisteav ihu, ad deitdachu.
May tama isteav. begin denafak egel, deihu missitra dismala, deihu shor, umimineh egel. veihu semala, kema deittemar, dichtiv
971: (Yechezkel 1:10) ufeni shor mehassemol learbatan. veaharon deihu yemina, itkelil beh semala, venafak al yedeh. veal da, ityeyhiv leh egel, kema deihu garim.

Uvegin kach, kad hay rucha mesaava ittakkaf, veshalit kemillekaddemin al alma, deha bezimna dechavu yisrael, amshichu alayyhu hahu yetzer hara kemillekaddemin. kad itdachu yisrael, uvau leitdakkaa, itzterichu lekarva sair, begin deshoir ihu chulaka dehahu yetzer hara, hahu ruach mesaava kidkamran.

Ketiv (Tehillim 106:20) vayyamiru et kevodam betavnit shor ochel esev. may tavnit shor. da egel. shor missitra dismala, aharon yemina, itkelil semala beh, veittakaf beh, venafak al yedeh. ta chaze, vayyamiru et kevodam, da shechinta, deazlat kamayyhu, veachlefu lah beducheta mesaava, el achara. uvegin kach la itabbar zuhama da mealma, ad hahu zimna diyavar leh kudesha berich hu mealma, kema deat amer (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattumea aavir min haaretz, veha okimna.

Ketiv (Shemot 32:24) vayaasehu egel massecha, uchetiv vaashlichehu vaesh vayyetze haeggel hazze, mashma dela aved leh, i hachi may vayyaasehu. ella vadday kema deokimna, deilmale aharon, la ittakkaf rucha mesaava leitkallela bedahava, aval kol tikkuna deitzterich, ashkach leitbenaa. (sefer acher laatarevaveah)
Ta chaze, it man deavid charshin veatzlach bidoy. veit man deavid lon kehahu gavvna mammash, vela atzlach bidoy, deha leovadin illen gavra metukkena itzterich.

Ta chaze mibbilam, deihu hava metukkena, leinnun charshin dileh, leatzlecha bidoy, begin dichtiv, (Bamidbar 24:3) uneum haggever shetum haayin. shetum haayin, setum haayin kolla chad. dechad ena satim tadir, vechezu deenoy la hava beorach (Vayikra 63 amud bet) meshar, muma hava beh beenoy. ketiv (Vayikra 16:21) veshillach beyad ish itti, zammin becholla, chazu deenoy dela yitkeshar. aval ruach kudesha, man deyishtammesh bahadeh ma ketiv, (Vayikra 21:18) kol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav ish ivver o fisseach.

Vehacha, kolla itkkan lerucha mesaava, lemehav leh ducheta leshalletaa. ashkach madbera deihu charuv mikkolla, kema dichtiv, (Devarim 8:15) nachash saraf veakrav vegomer, demittamman ihu shuletanuta dileh. ashkach dahava sippuka kedka yeot. ashkach aharon, leittatkefa bimina, uleitkalla beh. keden ashlim ducheteh kadka yeot, venafik veishtalim uvadda.

Umenalan deruach mesaava hava. dichtiv, (Shemot 32:31) ana chata haam hazze chataa gedola, da ruach mesaava, nachash kadmaa, kidkamran bechamma duchetin. uvezimna devaa aharon leitdakkea, akriv egel, mehahu sitra, lemebad beh dina. bekadmita aved leh leshalletaa, vehasheta deyaaved beh dina, leachpeyay leh, deha kad itavid dina besitra da, itkafyayn kol innun deshaltin missitreh.

Ta chaze, bemitzrayim, behahu sitra dilhon ketiv, (Shemot 12:9) al tochlu mimmennu na vegomer. tzeli esh, begin deyislak recho nodef. rosho al keraav, letavra leh uleachpeyay leh, ucheden kol innun deatyayn missitreh la shalte. kegavvna da (Bamidbar 19:2) fara adumma temima vegomer, begin leachpeyay kol innun sitre misava, dela yishletun.

Amar leh ribbi abba, veha para kaddisha ihi, dachya ihi, vaamay. amar leh hachi hu, veha ukemuha, kelala dearba malkevavn havat. para, kema deat amer (Hoshea 4:16) ki kefara sorera sarar yisrael. adumma, da malchut bavel, dichtiv, (Daniel 2:38) ant hu resha di dahava. temima, da malchut maday. asher en bah mum, da malchut yavan. (deinnun kerivin laarachey mayhamenavetaa) asher lo ala aleha ol, da malchut edom, dela salik aleh ol. veraza demilla da, af al gav dechamma millin ityeyhivu lemidrash bakkerae, kullehu chad.
Ha ittemar, dichtiv, (Iyov 14:4) mi yitten tahor mittame lo echad. mi yitten tahor
972: Mittame, raza da, hachi hu, deda ihu tahor denafak mittame. deha bekadmita tame, vehasheta deitavid beh dina, veityeyhiv likedat eshsha benura dedalik, veitavid afar, hasheta ihu tahor mittame, tahor denafik mittame.

Uvegin kach, kol innun demishtaddele bah, kullehu mistaave, deha hachi hu vadday, vechevan deitavid efer, keden ad deyitkenish veyistalik mittamman, masiv lechullehu, kema deat amer vechibbes haosef vegomer vetame. efer, may tama. kema deat amer (Malachi 3:21) veassotem reshaim ki yihyu efer tachat kappot raglechem. vechevan deityeyhiv al hahu efer mayim, keden ihu tahor mittame.

Veraza demilla, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 8) me chattat, kema deat amer (Bereshit 4:7) lappetach chattat rovetz. uvegin deihi petach chattat rovetz vadday, bekadmita ketiv, vehotzi otah el michutz lammachane. uvegin kach ityeyhivat lassegan, vela lechahana rabba, veda hu tahor mittame, bekadmita tame, vehasheta tahor. vechol setar ruach mesaava, kevan dechama da, arak, vela yativ behahu ducheta.

Me chattat vadday, me nidda, kolla mesaava. veal da shalta ruach kudesha, veruach mesaava itkafya, dela shalta kelal. veda hu dina deruach mesaava, michutz lammachane. begin deihi ruach mesaava, dichtiv, (Devarim 23:15) vehaya machanecha kadosh. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh.

Amar rabbi shimon, af al gav dechol hane millin kidkamran, kudesha berich hu yahiv leh shuletanu. veruach mesaava bae leachpeya leh bechol sitrin. ta veima lecha raza chada, vela ityeyhiv legallaa bar leinnun kaddishe elyonin.

Ta chaze, lehay atar deihu ruach mesaava. kudesha berich hu yahiv leh shuletanu, lemishlat bealma, bechamma sitrin, veyachil lenazka, velet leh (nusach acher lan) reshu, leanhaga beh kelana, devaenan leistammera minneh, dela yekatreg alan bego kedushsha dilan. veal da raza chada it lan, devaenan lemehav leh ducheta zeer, bego kedushsha dilan (dela ishtechach mekatrega bego kedushsha dilan) deha miggo kedushsha nafik shuletanu dileh.

Devaenan go raza ditfillin, leatznea (sod sear shabetapeyleyn) chad saara deegla, deyippuk levar veyitchaze. deha chuta desaara da la masiv, bar dei itchabbar hay saara, veitavid kashsheura, aval pachut min da la masiv. vehahu saara bae leaala leh bego kedushsha illaa dilan, ulemehav leh ducheta, begin dela yekatreg lan bekidushan.

Veyippuk min hahu saara levar, deyitchaze, dechad chame lehahu bar nash bikdushsha illaa, vechulaka dileh mishtattef letaman, keden la yekatreg leh, vela yachil leavasha leh leella vetatta, deha ducheta yehav leh. vei hahu chulaka la yahavin leh (ducheta) behay kedushsha, yachil leavasha leh letatta, vesalik mekatrega leh leella, veamar peloni deka mekaddesh hasheta, kach vechach avad yoma peloni, vechach innun chovoy, ad deyimte dina al hahu bar nash, veyitanesh al yedoy. (vechen sair hammishtalleach).

Vechacha havo yisrael avde, dahavo yade raza da, kad sharan leitkaddesha bikdushsha illaa beyoma dechippure, havo mistakkele miyyad lemehav chulakeh lehay atar, ulemehav leh chulaka benayyhu, begin dela yishtekach mekatrega alayyhu, vela yetun leadkera chovehon deyisrael. dechamma chavilin, vechamma mashiryayn, innun deizdammenan lenatla milla minneh, kad ate lekatrega. zakkaa chulakeh, man deyachil leistammera, dela yidkerun chovoy leella, vela yashgichun aleh levish.
Addehachi havo zalgin enoy deribbi abba. amar leh, abba abba, zil tanfir keturach, veakpid bekuletach, deha razin deorayyta lezakkae ityeyhivu dichtiv, (tehillim ko) sod Adonai lireav.

Ta chaze, beyoma derosh hashshana, alma ittedan, uve dina kaddisha (kudesha berich hu) yativ, vedan kol alma. vehahu sitra achara kaim missitra da, vechol innun deittedanu lemota ashgach alayyhu, veitreshimu kameh. uveshaata
973: Deyisrael mitare rachame, behahu kol shofar, keden itarveva leh kolla, dela yada vela mashgach, beinnun deittedanu. ad dilvatar kol innun dela mehaddere betiyyuveta, veigzar alayyhu mota, vadday nafkin pitkin mibbe malka, veitmesaru leh, kevan deitmesaru leh, la ahadru pitkin, ad deitavid dina.

Veyisrael kullehu, bayayn leistammera minneh, kol shekken bar nash bilchodoy. (vechol shekken vechol shekken) deha beraza illaa dilella, baenan leistammera, ulemehav leh bechol yarcha veyarcha, kad sihara bae leitchaddeta, chad sair, begin dela yekatreg chaddetuta (nusach acher chedvavta) veyittol chulakeh kadka chaze leh. vesihara kaddisha leyanka bikdushsha lechaddetute kedka yeot.

Vechad mitchaddesha bechol yarcha veyarcha, begin (Bereshit 149 amud bet) kach ikre naar, veha okimna. vehay achara da, deihu tadir bimsaavu, vela nafik minne, ikre melech zaken uchesil. uvegin kach, yisrael kaddishin deinnun amma chad, beyichuda kaddisha, kudesha berich hu yahiv lon eta, leishtezava mikkolla. zakkain innun bealma den, uvealma deate, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer.

(Shemot 39:33) vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe vegomer. ketiv (Yechezkel 1:26) umimmaal larakia, da ihu rekia, dekayyeyma alayyhu dearba chevavn, dechad mistalleke bego chad avera devatash behu, la zakfin resha leistakkela leella.
Begin dehahu ruach hachayya, batash bechullehu, uvehahu ruach mistalleke kullehu, dichtiv, uvehinnase hachayyot meal haaretz yinnasu haofannim leummatam. uchetiv ki ruach hachayya baofannim.

Amay mistalleke. ella kad batash hahu avira alayyhu, salik leillen arba ditchot hay chayya, veinnun salke lah leella, ad dematyayn lah legabbe zihara illaa, vehayeynu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha reoteha muvaot lach, begin dehane arba ikrun hachi, vela zazu min chayya da, deihi kuresyay, lealmin. vesallekin lah mittatta leella, leatkena kuresyay legabbe ella, veraza da (Bereshit 7:17) vayyisu et hatteva vattaram meal haaretz. vechad istalakat leella, veillen sallekin lah, keden ketiv, vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe.

Vayyaviu et hammishkan, kema deat amer muvaot lach, uchetiv vayyisu et hatteva. el moshe, kema deat amer demut kemare adam alav milmala, vehayeynu raza deadam. umenalan deikre adam, dichtiv, (Bereshit 6:3) la yadon ruchi vaadam leolam beshaggam hu basar, vehayeynu moshe. uvegin kach, al hay kuresyay, diyyukena deadam kayyeyma aleh, vehayeynu moshe. vayyaviu et hammishkan, illen arba chevavn, kad sallekin kidkamran.

Vayyaviu et hammishkan, illen kol shayyfin degufa, dechullehu betiuveta kaddisha, (amar rabbi avahu) kullehu achadin beh, leitdabbeka dechar venukeba kachada. vayyaviu et hammishkan, lemeal kalla lachuppa bekadmita, innun tzerichin lesalleka lah, uleayytaa lah legabbeh, ulevatar ihu yete legabbah tadir, veha (235 amud alef) okimna.

Vayyaviu et hammishkan, raza dechol innun dekashre kishrin deyichuda, veyachde yichuda deraze dimhemnuta kol yoma, (illen arba chevan) innun sallekin lah lechuresyay da, ad deatyayn lah legabbe moshe, vechevan dedavke lah legabbe moshe, keden innun havo deravvche birchan mimkora dechayye, al raza da, bekishshura deyichuda deinnun kishrin. veraza da, kad mitkashsherin yichuda decholla kadka yeot, veraza da ketiv, vayyar moshe et kol hammelacha vegomer, vayvarech otam moshe, ravvche birchan meatar darga demoshe sharya beh, veda ihu hachachamim haosim et kol melechet hakkodesh, begin deinnun yade lesaddera avidta dekudesha kadka chaze.
Veal da, kol man detzalle tzelota, (vekishshura) vekashir yichuda, mistakkelin beh i ihi tzelota vekishshura kedka yeot, vei hahi tzelota
974: Vehahu kishshura kedka yeot, keden itberach ihu bekadmita, meatar dechol birchan nafkin. hada hu dichtiv vehinne asu otah vegomer, miyyad vayvarech otam moshe.

Uvegin kach, vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe, deihu mare (Bereshit nusach acher amud bet) deveta, leachazaa betikkuna deveteh, veleh itzterich lemechoze tikkunaha verazin dilah, dela ityeyhivu leachara, leistakkela ulemechoze ba, beinnun sitrin uveinnun razin dilah, bar moshe bilchodoy.

Veal da vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe et haohel veet kol kelav. vechad ayytiu leh lemoshe, kolla ayytiu leh beshayyfin yedian, kol chad vechad leatkena, shayyfa beshayyfa, leaala da beda, vechad havo baan letakkena da beda, ulealaa da beda, la hava salik bidehon. kevan deayytiu leh lemoshe, miyyad kolla istalik bideh, vechol shayyfa veshayyfa hava istalik veal beducheteh, hada hu dichtiv, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan uchetiv hukam hammishkan, veha okimna.

Ta chaze, behahi shaata kad share moshe leakkama mishkena, veshaari leatkena tikkuna deshayyfin, leaala da beda. keden, itrefiu kol shayyfin vechol tikkunin desitra achara mesaava, kad share leatkefa hay sitra deihi kaddisha, itrafe sitra achara mesaava, ittakaf da veitrafe da. veha okimna, dechol zimna dehi bitkifu, sitra achara itrafan kol shayyfoy, da malya, veda charuv, veraza da yerushala 40 vetzor chayyayva, kad malya da, charuv da. veal da, kad ittakaf da itrafe da.

Uvegin kach, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan, leittakkefa meraza dilella, vela yitkaf meraza diltatta. veal da moshe dehava meraza dego aspakalarya denahara, itzterich ihu leakkama mashkena, leanhara minneh, vela meachara. (veal da) sihara itzterich leanhara min shimsha, vela meachara. ta chaze, keneset yisrael itzterichat leistalleka leella, uleitdabbeka go shimsha. (96 26 amud alef)

Patach veamar, (Vayikra 6:18) zot torat haola hi haola, amar rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai. ola seliku ukeshiru dekneset yisrael leella, vedibbuka dilah bego alma deate, lemehve kolla chad. ikre ola kodesh kodashim. uvegin kach ikre ola, desalleka veitattera lemeheve kolla chad. bekishshura chada bechidu.

Uvegin desalleka leella leella, ketiv zot torat haola. raza dechar venukeba kachada, tora shebbichtav vetora shebbeal pe. haola: desalleka go alma deate, leitkashshera begaveh, deikre kodesh hakkodashim vadday, veola name kodesh hakkodashim hi.

Uvegin kach, siddura dinchisu dilah listar tzafon, deihu setar semala. dehay tora shebbeal pe la salleka bachavivuta, ella kad atar sitra detzafon, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni, ucheden ihi salleka bachavivuta, veitattera bimina, veitchabbarat beemtzaita, veitnehir kolla, meraza dekodesh hakkodashim, veda miggo raza deadam, biru dechahana, uveshirata delevae, uvitzlota deyisrael.

Veha okimna, deola kodesh hakkodashim, beraza deruach illaa, begin ditlat ruchin keshirin kachada, ruach tattaa, deikre (Vayikra sefer acher amud alef) ruach hakkodesh ruach dilgo beemtzaita deikre ruach chachma uvina. vechen ikre ruach tattaa, aval hay ikre ruach denafik miggo shofar, kalul beeshsha uvemmaya. ruach illaa, deihu satim bachashay, deveh kayyman kol ruchin kaddishin, vechol anpin nehirin. uvegin kach, ahadrat ola ruach mammash.

Ulevatar, meraza divhema, mistappeke veittezanu, leitkashshera ruach achara deihu go mesaavu, meinnun tarbin veshamnunin kema deittemar. begin kach, ola kodesh hakkodashim, shear karbanin lemebad shelama bealma, kullehu mikkamma sitrin, umare dinin (nusach acher leitabbera) leitarva (nusach acher leitattera) uleitnahara miggo reuta leitbassema, ikrun kodashim kalim, begin dela mitattera leella
975: Leella bekkodesh hakkadashim, veal da innun kodashim kalim, unechisu dilhon bechol atar kema deokimna. aval ola deihu raza dekodesh hakkadashim, lav ihu kishar karbanin, dechol ovadaha kodesh.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv (Vayikra 6:3) velavash hakkohen mido vad, illen levushin meyaychadin likdushsha. bad: yechiday, meyachada likdushsha. uchetiv bigde kodesh hem verachatz bammayim et besaro ulevesham. may taama. (da kodesh) ella raza demilla kidkamran, deihi kodesh hakkadashim, desalleka kolla veitattera bekkodesh hakkadashim, bekishshura chada. ulevatar mafne veabar ruach misava desaiv kolla, dela shalta, vela yitkeriv go makdesha, veitabbar mikkol sitre kudesha, veishtear kolla kodesh bikdushsha yechiday.

Veamar ribbi shimon, ha ittemar (262 amud bet, 244 amud bet) dichtiv, (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai. vehachi salleka raza deadam, missitra deadam vadday. behema, missitra divhema. uvegin kach ketiv, (Vayikra 1:2) adam ki yakriv mikkem, adam vadday, deda karbaneh leella, lekashshera kishra beraza deadam. ulevatar min habbehema, vecholla ihu beraza deadam uvehema. veda hu raza deitzterich lekarbana, adam uvehema kidkamran. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, hachi avad adam uvehema.

Vei tema, veha ketiv (Bereshit 1:20) veof yeofef al haaretz, deha minnayyhu mekarvin karbanin, vaafillu ola, kema dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:14) veim min haof ola karbano. ta chaze, mikkol innun ofe, la mekarvin ella torim uvene yona, (ella raza da) ma deitkeshar beda, pasil beda da yemina, veda semala.

Aval raza da ha okimna, ketiv veof yeofef al haaretz, deinnun raza dirticha, uvehu istallak ruach hakkodesh, lesalleka leella, deinnun tere, chad limina, vechad lismala, of limina, veda michael. yeofef, lismala, veda (Bereshit 46 amud alef) gavriel. da limina veda lismala. uvegin kach, mekarvin teren illen, lesalleka ruach kudesha, usemala meatter vezayin letatta, lehahu setar semala. vimina limina veitkashshera itteta bevalah, lemeheve chad, vecholla istallak veitkashar kachada leella vetatta, vekudesha berich hu istallak bilchodoy veittakaf.
Uvesifre kadmae, miskena, la yahiv chulaka leattezana, ella leella leitkashshera, aval kolla leella vetatta mitkashar, kol chad vechad lesitreh kedka yeot, veha okimna. (Vayikra 26 amud bet)

Ribbi elazar shail leribbi shimon, amar, ha kishshura decholla (nusach acher deola), itkashar bekkodesh hakkadashim, leitnahara. itdabbekuta diruta dechahana velevae veyisrael leella, ad hechan (244 amud bet, 213 amud bet) ihu salleka.

Amar leh, ha okimna, ad en sof, dechol kishshura veyichuda ushelimu, leatznea behahu tzeniu, dela itdabbak, vela ityeyda, deraava dechol raavin beh, en sof la kayyeyma leodaa, velav lemebad sof, velav lemebad rosh, kema deayin kadmaa appik rosh vesof. man rosh. da nekuda illaa, deihu resha decholla setimaa, dekayyeyma go machashava. veavid sof, deikre (Kohelet 12) sof davar. aval lehatam, en sof.

Lav reutin, lav nehorin, lav butzinin, behahu en sof, kol illen butzinin unehorin, talyayn leitkayyeyma behu, vela kayyma leitdabbeka man deyada vela yada, lav ihu ella reu illaa, setima dechol setimin, ayin. (96 26 amud bet)

Vechad nekuda illaa, vealma deate, istelaku, la yade bar recha, keman dearach berecha veitbasam. velav da nayycha nichoach, deha ketiv (Vayikra 26:31) velo ariach bariach nichochachem, deha reach nichoach, recha diruta dechol hane reuta ditzlota, ureuta deshirata, ureuta dechahana, dechullehu raza deadam. keden kullehu itavidu reuta chada, vehahu ikre nichoach, raava, ketargumo. keden kolla itkashar veitnehir kachada, kedka yeot, kema deittemar.
Veal da ityeyhivat hay sitra achara, bida dechahana, dichtiv, (Vayikra 6:2) tzav et aharon
976: Veet banav lemor, raza hacha, deha okimna let tzav ella avodat kochavim umazzalot, vehacha ityeyhivat leh, leittokda hahi machashava raa, uleabera lah miggo kudesha, behay reuta desalleka leella, uveha tenana, vetarbin deittokdan. begin leitabbera min kudesha. vehay tzav, birshutayyhu kayyeyma, leafrasha lah min kudesha, miggo hay karbana. vei tema (Bamidbar 28) tzav et beni yisrael. hachi name, deha birshutayyhu kayyeyma, (davar acher leafrasha la min kedushsha) kol zimna deavde reuta demarehon, dela yachla leshalletaa alayyhu.

Vehay kera kolla, atya leachazaa raza demilla, leattera lehahu ruach kudesha, leella leella, uleafresha lah leda ruach tumea, lenachta lah letatta letatta, da biruta uvitzlota kidkamran, veda beovada, kolla kidkachaze leh.

Vehay kera mochach alayyhu, dichtiv, tzav et aharon veet banav lemor. tzav: da avodat kochavim umazzalot ruach misava. lemor: (58 60 amud alef) da itteta, deikre (Mishlei lo) yirat Adonai. ketiv hacha lemor, uchetiv hatam lemor (Yirmeyahu 3:1) hen yeshallach ish et ishto, veha ukemuha. uvegin kach, kolla ittemar, vechahana kayyeyma leatkena kolla, beraza (244 amud bet) deadam uvehema. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, bealma den, uvealma deate, leinnun yade arche deorayyta, veazle bah beorach keshot, alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 38:16) Adonai alehem yichyu. may alehem. illen archoy deorayyta. yichyu, yitkayymu behay alma, uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, ketiv zot torat haola, amar ribbi chiyay, hay kera okimna leh behay gavvna, zot torat: da keneset yisrael. haola: deihi salkat veitatterat leella leella, leitkashshera kedka yeot, ad atar deikre kodesh hakkadashim.

Davar acher, zot torat: da keneset yisrael. haola: da machashava raa, deihi salleka al reuta devar nash, leastaa leh meorcha dikshot. hi haola, hi hi desalleka, veastiat leh levar nash, bae leokda leh benura, begin dela yityayhiv lah ducheta (nusach acher leastaa) leasgaa.

Uvegin kach, al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla, man layla, da keneset yisrael. (deihi zot begin) deatya ledakkea leh levar nash, mehahu reuta. al mokda. begin di nahar dinur, ihu atar leokda lechol innun, dela kayyme bekiyyumayyhu, deha alin lon behahu nora dedalik, umeabbere shuletanehon mealma. uvegin dela yishlot, itzterich al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla, veitkafyay vela shalta.

Veal da, kad itkafyay hay, salleka keneset yisrael, deihi ruach kudesha, desalleka veitattera leella, deha seliku dilah, kad itkafyay hay chela achara, veitparsha minnah. uvegin kach, baenan beraza dekarbena, leafrasha lehay sitra meruach kudesha, ulemehav lah chulaka, begin deruach kudesha istallak leella.

Veta chaze, bezimna deitbene be makdesha, veitavid. itkafyay sitra achara, veistallak mealma. vechad istallak mealma, veittekam mashkena al yeda demoshe, keden ittekam leella vetatta. hada hu dichtiv, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan. may vayyakem. ella deokim lah, leistalleka leella leella. veal da, vayyakem moshe, man dehava maich ukemeh, keman deokim leman denafil. kegavvna da, lezimna deate ketiv (Amos 9:11) akim et sukkat david hannofelet.

Ketiv, (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael, may lo tosif kum. (mashma dechad zimna achara kamat) ella bezimna achara kamat. hi kamat miggarmah, vela okim lah kudesha berich hu. deha begaluta demitzrayim, kudesha berich hu okim lah, veavad kama nissin, begin leakkama lah, uvegaluta devavel hu la okim lah, begin dela avad lon nissim, degarim chova, ella hi kamat. useliku bene gola, keinnun dela hava lon paroka, vela hava tiuveta dekudesha berich hu alayyhu, begin degaram hahu chova,
977: Veal da, kudesha berich hu la okim lah lichneset yisrael, vela aved lah nissin ugevuran behahu zimna kedka yeot. aval lezimna deate, lo tosif kum ketiv, la tosif, kum miggarmah, ella kudesha berich hu yokim lah, dichtiv akim et sukkat david hannofelet. uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 30:9) veet david malkam asher akim lahem. uvegin kach ketiv hacha, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan. vayyakem moshe vegomer.

Ta chaze, kad okim leh moshe lemashkena, ittekam mashkena achara immeh. umashkena illaa, okim (nusach acher okir) vesaid kolla, begin demashkena illaa, satim veganiz ihu leella leella. umashkena achara ittekam al mashkena diltatta vekayyeyma alleh, (sefer acher immeh. umashkena ilaa hahu desatim veganiz leella leella okim vesaid kolla. umashkena achara hahu ittakam al yeda demashkena diltatta kayyeyma aleh) bechela dehahu mashkena illaa al kolla. vechamma deittekam mashkena diltatta al yeda demoshe, uf hachi leella, al yede dehahu debane demoshe (nusach acher darga demoshe). menalan. dichtiv, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan. et dayyka, leitchazzaa ditre mashkenin beraza demoshe ittekanu (nusach acher atekamev).

Amar ribbi yose, vechi vayyakem moshe, veha kolla ad la ittakkan, vekima lav ihu ella kad ishtelim kolla, veal shayyfa beshayyfeh, may vayyakem. amar ribbi yitzchak, bitlat sitrin okim moshe yat mashkena, ma ketiv vayyakem moshe et hammishkan, vayitten et adanav, vayyasem et kerashav. behani telat sitre, okim moshe yat mashkena. uvehane telat sitre, istallak mashkena. veitkafyay sitra achara. vavoda zara, kad okim moshe lehay sitra, itkafyay sitra achara. begin kach moshe okim leh vela achara.

Ta chaze, ketiv vayitten et adanav, behahi shaata izdaza samael meatrih, vearbein retichin deimmeh, vearak arba mea parse, go tesiru denukeba deafra. ail moshe innun samchin, veittakif sitra da, keden innun samchin desitra achara, naflu veitrefu.

Patach veamar, bayom hahu akim et sukkat david hannofelet vegomer, may bayom hahu. beyoma dekudesha berich hu yabid dina bealma, veyifkod al chayyayve alma keovadehon. deha let kima lichneset yisrael meafra, beod deinnun chayyayvin deyisrael yekumun bealma. ma ketiv leella, (Amos 9:10) bacherev yamutu kol chattae ammi haomrim lo tagish vetakdim baadenu haraa. ma ketiv batreh, bayom hahu akim et sukkat david hannofelet vegomer.

Hay kera it leistakkela beh, (Amos) et pirtzehen, et pirtzah mibbae leh. vaharisotav, vaharisoteha mibbae leh. ella vegadarti et pirtzehen mimman, meinnun chayyayvin, dichtiv bacherev yamutu kol chattae ammi, deha keden yitavid pirtzan beyisrael, veal da vegadarti et pirtzehen. vaharisotav akim, harisotav deman, harisotav desukkat david. (mimman middavid) begin, dechad ittakaf malchu chayyayva bealma, keden hay malchu kaddisha itrafe, vesukkat david astir binyayna dileh, veal da vaharisotav akim.

Deha tanenan, kol zimna dehay ittakaf, hay itrafe. da malya, veda charva. uvegin kach, ad hahu yoma, malchu chayyayva yitkaf. behahu yoma, yittakaf veyokim lah kudesha berich hu, lehay malchu kaddisha. veal da vaharisotav akim. uvenitiha kime olam, may uvenitiha kime olam. hayeynu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma vegomer.

(Shemot 39) vayyakem moshe et hammishkan, bemay okim leh. dichtiv vayitten et adanav veyahav innun samchin ditchoteh, lekayyeyma alayyhu, uleaschara behu innun tzirim defitchin. begin deinnun samchin ditchotayyhu, innun kiuma leaschara. amay vayitten. atkif veatkin lon betukefoy. behahi shaata adiu innun samchin acharanin desitra achara.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Tehillim 137:7) zechor Adonai livni edom et yom yerushala 40 haomrim aru aru ad hayesod ba. veal da zammin kudesha berich hu lemivne yesode yerushala 40, miysodin acharanin, deyishletun al kolla. uman innun. sappirin. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:11) visadtich bassappirim, deillen innun yesodin, vesamchin takkifin veillain, delet lehu chalishu kekadmae. may taama. begin deavanin
978: Kadmain meinnun yesode, yachilu shear ammin lemishlat alayyhu. may taama. begin delet behu nehiru illaa, kedka yeot. aval illen, yehon nehirin miggo nehiru illaa, umeshakkean go tehome, dela yachlin leshalletaa alayyhu. veillen innun sappirin, deyinharun leella vetatta. (vei tema) begin divhahu zimna, yittosaf nehiru illaa, leella vetatta.

Vei tema innun yesode kadmae, yitvattelun. ha ketiv (Yeshayahu 54:11) hinne anochi marbitz bappuch avanayich. marbitz leatkena tevira. may bappuch. kema deat amer (Melachim 2 9:30) vattasem bappuch eneha. avanim it deikrun puch. may taama hay. amar ribbi elazar raza ihu, veraza da limchatzde chakla ityeyhiv leminda.

Ta chaze, innun avanin diysode tziyyon viyrushalam, chas veshalom dishlitu alayyhu shear ammin, vela okdu lon, vela ittokdun, ella kullehu itgenizu, veganiz lon kudesha berich hu, vechol innun yesode beta kaddisha kullehu itgenizu, vela itavidu minnayyhu afillu chad. vechad yehdar kudesha berich hu veyokim lah liyrushalam al atreh, innun yesode avanin kadmae, yahadrun leatrayyhu, vela yashlit behu ena achara (nusach acher bisha), bar bezimna deyichchol bar nash enoy behahu pucha, veyimle eneh minneh, ucheden yecheme kol avanin vechol yesode yerushala 40, metukkenan al atrayyhu, dela shalitu behu shear ammin, vechol innun avanin yekarin acharanin, vechol innun binyayni avanin, kullehu kayyme al kiumayyhu.

Ucheden (Yeshayahu 52:8) ki ayin beayin yiru beshuv Adonai tziyyon. may beshuv Adonai. ella kad shelitu alah shear ammin, kudesha berich hu salik lah leella, uvehahu zimna ihu yehdar lah leatrah, dichtiv beshuv Adonai tziyyon. beshuv Adonai vadday.

Veta chaze, kol man deastim min ena, vela ityeyhiv reshu leshalletaa beh ena, la yachlin lemishlat beh ena, bar bechichla deena, bemillin yedian. uvegin kach, hinni anochi marbitz bappuch avanayich. veta chaze, kol illen avanin yitkayyeymun beatrayyhu, velehevo yisodin kekadmeta, visode sappirin (acharanin) yitkayyeymun baatar achara sacharana, lefuteya ulearka, hada hu dichtiv visadtich bassappirim.
Bezimna deyokim kudesha berich hu leveteh, behahu zimna ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach. billa, kidamrinan (Eicha 2) billa Adonai velo chamal, hahu kos deshata hay, yishte hay.

Vei tema, hahu billa ihu lizman yedia vekatziv keyisrael, lav hachi. ketiv lanetzach, may lanetzach. ledare darin. velav keyisrael, velav kehahu zimna deokim moshe yat mashkena. ella lanetzach lealmin.

Ucheden kudesha berich hu yokim lah likkenset yisrael, veihu yokim samchin, vesefe, vechol innun tikre beta, betikkunoy, (sefer acher bitkifu) lealam ulealme almayya. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 54:2) harechivi mekom oholech vegomer, begin deyitvela sitra achara, vela yekum lealmin ucheden, (Yeshayahu 25:8) vecherpat ammo yasir meal kol haaretz ki Adonai dibber.

(Shemot 39) vayyakem moshe et hammishkan, behahu zimna deillen samchin ittekamu, veityeyhivu beatrayyhu, hahu zimna itrefu veitavaru meatrayyhu samchin baatar setar achara, veal da, veyyitten et adanav.

May veyyitten. ella olifna, dechama moshe lekammeh lesamael chayyayva, dehava azil legabbeh lekatrega leh, ucheden atkif beh moshe, vekashir leh kammeh, veokim leh lemashkena, veyahav lesamchoy. dichtiv veyyitten et adanav. veyyitten: bitkifu, dela yachil bar nash achara leshalletaa aleh, ulemehav samchin beatrayyhu, kemoshe. deha bitkifu rav, okim leh moshe.

Behahu yoma deittekam mashkena, kad shaari moshe leakkama leh, bechad benisan hava, uvehahu zimna, tekifu desitra achara hava bealma, deha beyome denisan, resh tora bedikula (salik leigra). tanenan. uvenisan share moshe, vechama leh lesamael, azil sacharaneh, learbeva leh, veitgabbar aleh moshe, ucheden, vayyitten et adanav. share hu veyahav letatta, veshari man deshari veyahav
979: Beyoma deittekam hay mashkena letatta, ittekam mashkena achara kaddisha leella, umashkena illaa tamir veganiz, appik nehorin lechol setar, veitnaharun almin.

Ribbi yose shail leribbi shimon, amar leh, telat mashkenin chamenan bakkera, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 9:15) uveyom hakim et hammishkan, kissa heanan et hammishkan leohel haedut, uvaerev yihye al hammishkan kemare esh ad boker, ha telat mashkenin hacha. vaamay mashkena, vela bayit, deha bayit itzterich vela mishkan.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 66:1) ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vegomer. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu itree behu beyisrael leachasanteh veadveh, vekariv lon legabbeh. veha okimna deavad minnayyhu dargin yedian behay alma, kegavvna dilella, leshachlela almin kullehu kechad, ella vetatta. dichtiv hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay leshachlela ella vetatta lemehve chad.

Ta chaze, hashshamayim kisi, da rekia deyaakov sharya beh, deihu diyyukena illaa, lechuresyay (sefer acher kuresyay illaa lediyyukena) illaa kaddisha. vehaaretz hadom raglay, da rekia dedavid malka sharya beh, leithanaa mizziva deasfakalarya denahara. uvegin devae leitpashta yattir letatta amar hadom raglay. eze vayit asher tivnu li, da binyan bet makdesha. veeze makom menuchati, da bet kodesh hakkadashim diltatta.

Aval ta chaze, kol zimna deazlu yisrael bemadbera, hava lehu mishkan, ad deatu leshilo, vahava tamman. veda ihu raza, leamshacha da beda, uleaala da beda, leitkashshera da beda, begin leanhara. aval lav lenayycha. deha lav nayycha, bar kad itbene be makdesha, beyomoy dishlomo malka, deha keden ihu menucha leella vetatta. begin detamman tekifu denayycha, vela lenatla meatar laatar.

Uvegin kach it mishkan, veit bayit. mishkan: kema deat amer, (Vayikra 26:11) venatatti mishkani betochchem velo tigal nafshi etchem. may mishkani. mishkenotav dekudesha berich hu, delihvon gabbayyhu deyisrael. may taama. begin dichtiv velo tigal nafshi etchem.

Ma ben hay lehay. ella mishkan, kemalka deate legabbe rechimeh, vela mayyte kol uchlusin dileh immeh, begin dela leatrecha aleh, ihu ate legabbeh bizer chelin. bayit: dechol chelin vechol (Vayikra 2 amud bet) ochlosin dileh, kullehu ayyte immeh, ledayyeyra behahu beta, veda ihu ben mishkan uven bayit. bet hammikdash, ihu diyyura denayycha lealmin, bechol innun retichin, bechol innun diukenin, bechol innun ovadin, kegavvna dilella. letabbera (davar acher lechabbera) ovadin diltatta, kegavvna dilella. mishkan, bizer diukenin, bizirin ovadin, lenatla meatar laatar, vecholla beraza dilella.

Ta chaze, kad pakid kudesha berich hu lemoshe al mashkena, la hava yachil lemekam beh, ad dekudesha berich hu achme leh kolla bediukeneh, kol milla umilla. bemma achze leh. beeshsha chivvavra, uveeshsha uchama, uveeshsha sumaka, uveeshsha yeroka. ma ketiv, (Shemot 25:40) uree vaase ketavnitam asher atta mare bahar. im kol da akshe leh lemoshe.

Ta chaze, af al gav deachze leh ena beena la baa moshe lemebad. vei tema deihu la yada lemebad, o chachmeta la hava immeh. ta chaze, betzalel veoholiav, vechol innun shear acharanin, af al gav dela chamu kemoshe, ma ketiv, vayyar moshe et kol hammelacha vehinni asu otah vegomer, i innun dela chamu, avdu kach. moshe dechama, al achat kama vechamma. ella moshe, af al gav deistallak min mashkena meavidata, kolla hava bideh, veal yedeh, veihu ikre al shemeh, veal da ketiv uree vaase.
Davar acher, moshe istallak min da, veyahiv ducheteh leachara, ad deamar leh kudesha
980: Berich hu (Shemot 31:2) ree karati veshem betzalel, veitto oholiav. uchetiv veasa betzalel veoholiav vechol ish chacham lev. i yekara da, hava demoshe, deihu yabid leh, yitkeyyaym beh tadir. (sefer acher yattir tadir)

Veim kol da, kevan deihu pakid, uvefikudeh yitavid, ihu avid kolla. tu, kol avidta la kayyeyma, ella besiuma deovada, veal da, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan. bau leakkama leh kol innun chakkime libba, vela hava mitkayyem, begin yekareh demoshe, ad deata moshe, veokim leh. veha ukemuha.

(Shemot 40:18) vayyakem moshe et hammishkan ribbi yehuda patach, (Micha 7:8) al tismechi oyavti li ki nafalti kamti vegomer. man oyavti li. devavu demalchu chayyayva bemalchut kaddisha. vehay kera keneset yisrael amar leh, al tismechi oyavti li ki nafalti kamti, ma delet lach hachi (nusach acher la hachi) lemalchu achara, dechevan detippol la takum lealmin. aval keneset yisrael, af al gav denaflat, takum vekamat shear zimnin. dichtiv ki nafalti kamti.

Deha kama zimnin naflat keneset yisrael begaluta, veyatva ben innun mare devavu, ushear ammin kamu alayyhu deyisrael leshetzaa lon mealma, (velo yachilu) kema deat amer, (Tehillim 83:4) al ammecha yaarimu sod, uchetiv ki noatzu lev yachdav vegomer, amru lechu venachchidem miggoy. veim kol da, af al gav dishar ammin kamu alayyhu, kudesha berich hu la anach lon bidayyhu, vei naflu kamu, dichtiv ki nafalti kamti. deha kudesha berich hu akim lah tadir.

Uzemina keneset yisrael, lomar behahu zimna dekudesha berich hu yokim lah meafra degaluta, vetistalak minneh, al tismechi oyavti li ki nafalti kamti. ki nafalti begaluta, veishtabedu banay, kamti behay zimna. uvegin kach, behahu zimna deappik moshe lon leyisrael, kad aved lon kudesha berich hu innun nissin ugevuran deavad lon. keden vayyakem moshe et hammishkan ketiv, deha al yeda demoshe ittekam bechol zimna.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Yechezkel 1:21) belechtam yelechu vegomer. belechtam yelechu uveamdam yaamodu. hay kera it leistakkela beh. belechtam yelechu, vechi la yedana deha belechtam yelechu, uveamdam yaamodu. ella belechtam deman. belechtam dechayyot. dechad innun azlin, innun ofannim yelechu. kema deat amer uvelechet hachayyot yelchu haofannim etzlam. veal da belechtam yelechu uveamdam yaamodu, begin dechol matalnehon deinnun ofannim, lav innun ella bematlanin dechayyot, vekiyyuma dilhon la kayyme beatrayyhu, ella kolla talya bachayot. vechen ketiv uvehinnase hachayyot meal haaretz yinnasu haofannim leummatam begin dechayyot veofannim kachada azlin.

Veta chaze, esrin vearba mashkkofin, dematranin illain kayymin go mashkofa chada devistar mizrach. lehay pitcha, natrin arba veesrin mishmarot, temirin go tukepa deshalhova, deatara vesachara lego hahu mashkofa mehahu sitra demizrach.

Vearba veesrin samchin techotayyhu, veal illen samchin kayymin esrin vearba ammudin, veillen innun dekayymin tadir, vela parchin go avera keinnun acharanin, veillen innun deikrun omdim, kema deat amer, (Zecharya 3:7) venatatti lach mahlechim ben haomdim haelle. veillen ammudim, kayymin al innun samchin, behu sacharan leitkayyeyma beduchetayyhu.

Kad illen ammudim kayymin al kiumayyhu, kullehu shallitin dekayymin alayyhu, meaffe vetasin kol alma, veashgechan ayynin. veinnun detzayyti kalin, sallekin millin leella, kema deat amer (Kohelet 10:20) ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol. uvegin kach, innun samchin kayymin bekiyyuma tadir.
Ta chaze, belechtam yelechu kidkamran. uvehinnasseam meal haaretz yinnasu haofannim
981: Leummatam. deha kema deillen chayot natlin vesallekin, hachi innun. may taama. begin, ki ruach hachayya baofannim. ruach hachayya, ruach kudesha, denashiv uvatash bechullehu ofannim, lemehach. ishtechach, dechol man deihu bedarga illaa, ihu natil leman denatil leh. ta chaze, dearon ihu hava natil leman denatil leh. uf hacha, chayot, innun natlin laofannim.
Vei tema ki ruach hachayya baofannim ketiv. hachi name, da chayya, deihu listar yemina, listar semala, velistar kama, velistar achora, veda ihi chayya, veillen innun chayot.

Ketiv (Yechezkel 10:20) hi hachayya asher raiti tachat elohe yisrael binhar kevar, da hi chayya dimrabba learba sitrin dealma. veda ihi dekayyeyma kuresyay, lediyyukena deadam. kema dichtiv, veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav milmala. vecholla lehahu darga illaa kaddisha setimaa, deikre elohe yisrael.

Veda chayya diltatta, dekayyeyma techot kullehu chevavn illain kaddishin. begin deit chevavn illain illen al illen. kuresyay ditchot elohe yisrael, da diyyukena deyaakov. vechuresyay diltatta, da diyyukena dedavid. ihi dimrabbea learba sitrin dealma. uvegin kach rucha nafik milleella, venagid veitmeshach middarga ledarga, ad devatash bechullehu tattae diltatta, vehahu rucha anhig lecholla, veatkin tikkuna dechullehu leatkena.

(Sefer acher behahu gavvna mammash deit tikkuna leella behahu vechulei) uvehahu gavvna mammash, ittakkan letatta. ma ketiv leella, ki ruach hachayya baofannim. uchetiv el asher yihye shamma haruach lalechet yelchu. letatta ma ketiv, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan. bemma. (sefer acher lemay) lemeheve ruach dehahu darga diltatta, behahu diyyukena dehahu ruach illaa, hi hachayya asher raiti tachat elohe yisrael, umehay chayya nafka rucha leatkena kolla. hachi name moshe. hi hachayya deyahav rucha letatta, leatkena kolla. begin kach ketiv, vayyakem, vayitten, vayyasem. uvecholla shavvi rucha, leatkena kolla.

Ta chaze, bekadmita, bemashkena deavad moshe, ihu atkin leh, beraza dehahu darga illaa deihu kayyeyma beh. bemakdesha deavad shelomo, ihu takkin leh, beraza dehahu nahar denafik meeden, deihu shelama deveta, veihu nayycha deveta. veal da beraza demashkena, ihu kureba dachavivuta, bedarga (sefer acher beraza) degufa, hahu darga demoshe, kayyeyma beh kureba dachavivuta, velav denayycha. kad ata shelomo, veatkin makdesha, hahu makdesha ittakkan, beraza dachavivu denayycha. veal da ketiv bishlomo, (divrei hayamim 1 22:9) hu yihye ish menucha.
Uvegin kach, da atkin bechad darga, veda atkin bechad darga, diyyukena dehay behay, veraza da, (Bereshit 37:2) elle toldot yaakov yosef.

Sheruta deshaari moshe, leatkena behay atar, deihu sitra dikdushsha okim kima dinkuda dekayyeyma beemtzaita, dehava chashuch veshakua beatreh, vela itchaze, vela nahir kelal, vesheruta decholla okim lah lehay nekuda, deishtekaat beatraha. ulevatar lechol achara, deihu binyayna dehay nekuda.
