Veim hay nekuda la ittakkan (nusach acher atetakem) bekadmita, kol man deitpashshat minnah, la yachil leittakna. vechevan dehay nekuda ittekamat veitnehirat, keden, kol shear tikkuna achara ittakkan, veityeyshavat beduchetah. veal da, vayyakem moshe et hammishkan. (et) da nekuda dahavavt chashocha ushekia beatreh. ulevatar, vayyitten et adanav, innun samchin deinnun mikkan umikkan. (begin deit adanim veit adanim) vechullehu havo mea lecheshbona, vechullehu itpelagu leatrayyhu, dichtiv, meat adanim limat hakkikkar kikkar laaden.
982: Ha okimna, aval la ketiv behu kima, ella vayyitten, netina leshavvava alayyhu ma deitzterich, begin deit tattain veillain, rechivin da al da. veal da ketiv behu netina.
Behahi shaata dehay nekuda ittekamat, ishtekaat sitra achara. vela itmachat kelal, deha la itmeche, ella lehahu zimna deate, deitmeche mealma, kema deittemar, ittekam da veishtekaat da.

(Shemot 40:18) vayyitten et adanav, keden shaari leittatkefa hay sitra (davar acher rucha) dikdushsha vechad ityeyhivu illen samchin, ishtekau kullehu desitra achara, vealu benukeba dithoma rabba. begin deistallak hay sitra dikdushsha illaa, veihu chulaka leistalleka, ucheden hay sitra achara ishteka, veal behahu nukeba dithoma.

Veilmale deyisrael chavu, (bekadmita) la yachil leshalletaa bealma yattir. ulevatar uf hachi chavu, veamshichu leh alayyhu kekadmeta. umehahu yoma, la hava eta, ella lemehav chulaka lehahu sitra achara becholla, beraza dekarbenin unesachin veillavavn. veta chaze begin kach ola ittokda kolla beeshsha, leachpeyay hay sitra, uleistalleka sitra dikdushsha, uvegin kach kad moshe okim laatar da. ishteka atar da.

Ta chaze vayyakem moshe, hay sitra dikdushsha. veishteka sitra achara mesaava. vayyitten. lehay sitra dikdushsha, veitrafya hay sitra achara mesaava. vayyasem, lehay sitra dikdushsha, veitkafya hay sitra achara dimsaava. ulevatar ahdar vayitten et berichav.

Ulevatar vayyakem. may tama. begin diyhe sheruta vesiyyuma bekima, shaari bekima, vesiyyem bekima. begin divcholla bae kima, sheruta vesiyyuma. kima besheruta desitra achara itrafe. veda, ihu kima lesitra dikdushsha, begin leitkayyeyma uleistalleka leella, lemehve itkashruta chada kedka yeot. begin dechol zimna dikdushsha shalta vesalleka, mesaavu shafil, umaich letatta.
Resha dinkuda, dekayyeyma techot dargin di besitra achara, ihu rish darga dilvar, resha didchura, vekayyeyma rachiv al chad gamal, ihu resha levar dechad irvuva dechoshech deitpashshat.
Dechad tenana nafka miggo rugeza takkif, itpashshat hahu tenana, veazil rugeza batar rugeza, da al da, veda rachiv veshalit al da, bechezu didchar venukeba lemehve kolla rugeza takkif.
Vechad shaari tenana leitpashsheta, dachik miggo rugeza bidchiku dechad nekuda leitpashsheta, ulevatar itpashshat tenana (130 amud alef) derugeza beakkimu, kechad chivya chakkim leavasha.

Resha denafka leitpashsheta, ihu darga deihu chashuch, salik venachit, azil veshat, venach beducheteh, vekayyeyma darga leityayshsheva, mehahu tenana denafik miggo rugeza, veihu tzel. tzilla, al atar achara deikre mavet. vechad mitchabberan tarvavyyhu kachada, ikre (vayyetze 160 amud bet) tzalmavet, veha okimna, terin dargin innun demitchabberan kachada.

Hay tzel, ihu sheruta dinkuda tattaa dilvar, chashocha dimrachaka minkuda kaddisha, dekayyeyma beemtzaita. vehay ihu nekuda, dela kayyeyma, vela itreshimat begavvnaha. uminah itpashshetat peshitu levar uletatta. veihi ishtekaat vela itchaziat, vela itreshimat.

Hay itpashshetat letatta, limina velismala, veitpashtat beemtzaita, go chashuch, kavel elef umea. teren samchin mitgallefin lesitra da, ulesitra da, itpashshat chashocha, bego gon ucham vela ucham, deha let leh gon leitkayyeyma beh. uvehahu peshitu, kayymin chashuchin innun deshimmeshu bemitzrayim, dichtiv (Shemot 10:23) lo reu ish et achiv velo kamu ish mittachtav sheloshet yamim. uchetiv veyamesh choshech.
983: Hay peshitu, itpashat bechamma zinin, meshanyayn illen go illen. go hahu peshitu, nafka chad zihara deitzteba bedahava, veda ihu dahava sumaka. itpashat hay zihara, vechafe chashuch derisha, veihu dahava, deitkelil beh chashocha.
Hay chashocha itpashat limina velismala. umiggo illen teren sitrin, nafka chad gavvna dechaspa, dela zahir. itpashat hay gon dichsaf, vechafe chashocha, veitkelil da beda, venachit letatta.
Itpashat chashocha, vekayyman teren chashuchin, resh uchama dekayymin, (davar acher denafkin) umittamman mitpashshat venafik chad gon dinchoshet.
Umittamman itpashshat letatta, hahu chashuch, vekaim kayyeyma, venafik chad gon ucham chezu defarzela. vecholla beraza dachashocha.
Mibben teren kayymin, nafik kayyayma chad, chashuch bachashocha, vechol illen gavvnin itchazun beh. vehay ihu arla, deanhig dechar linkeva, leizdavvevga kachada, lemeheve chad.

Hane kayymin, bez dargin ravrevin (dichrin) yedian. darga kadmaa, ihu darga dekaim besitra dehay chashocha. da chashocha salleka, go temiru ditnana deeshsha, hay kalil begavevn tenana, uvegavevn eshsha, uvegavevn ucham. illen telat gavvnin, mitparshan lechamma sitrin, leitakkema beimke alma.

Gon tenana hay, nachta lealma, veail lechamma sitrin, veda itpashat bealma, veaste leruche bene nasha birgizu, leastaa archayyhu, uleittakkefa berugezayyhu. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 81:10-11) lo yihye vecha el zar velo tishtachave leel nechar. lo yihye vecha el zar da dechura. velo tishtachave leel nechar da nukeba. hay ihu rugeza deshalta veittakaf bealma, veal bego bene nasha, veatkif lon leavasha.

Gon eshsha, hay gavvna nachta lealma, veal lechamma sitrin, leavasha, lekatla, uleoshda damin, ulekappecha livne nasha. veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 1:11) im yomru lecha ittanu neerva ledam nitzpena lenaki chinnam. begin deit oshde damin lemaggana, vekatle lemaggana. veit deoshde damin vekatle bikrava, vehay missitra didchura vehay missitra denukeba. sitra didchura oshid damin lemaggana, kidkamran. sitra denukeba, leaggacha keravin, uleitkattela illen beillen, vechol keravin vekatolin illen beillen, mehahu sitra denukeba ka atyayn.

Gon ucham, hay gavvna nachta lealma, venachta leitmanaa al kol petzuin, umachyayn, utefisu degufin, utzelivu, vachaniku, leavasha tadir livne nasha. illen telat gavvnin, mitparshan lechamma sitrin dealma, veitpashshetan go bene alma.

Gon tenana nachta bealma, vehay ihu gon kadmaa, denafka miggo nekuda deshakia mehahu tzel dekaamaran, deihu samael, deka rachiv al gamal, kema deittemar, vehay gon tenana ikre katzpiel ravreva. vehay ihu rugeza divne nasha, deatkifu libba berugeza.

Techot hay, memanan elef veshit mea chavilin, deinnun rugeza degufayyhu divne nasha. begin deit rugeza deshalta bealma lemebad dina. aval hay (sitra) ihu rugeza, deshalta veal begufayyhu divni nasha, deitregizu behay rugeza. vehay rugeza, ihu yesoda dechol shear gevavne, lemebad behu, binyayna leavasha, begin dehay tenana, nafka miggo rugeza deeshsha illaa, dimlahata, vehay ihu kadmaa lehahu eshsha.

Arba rugeze mitparshan mehahu rugeza. rugeza kadmaa, ikre rogez veda ihu deargiz libbayyhu divne nasha, veda ihu denachta veazla vesatya livne nasha, veitregizu berugezayyhu. veda ihu deamshich mechabbela al alma. (veal da ketiv 0 barevagez rechem tizkor)
Rugeza tinyayna, hay ihu nachta lealma, veshat veitpashshat lechol sitrin, vehay ikre sina. vehay nachta veal bivne nasha, vehay kevan deal, ikre mechabbela shetika
984: Vehay ihu ragza deshatik, vehay ihu deishtattef behahu atar denukeba. vehay ihu rugeza dishtika, dekayyeyma beakkimu. hay kashya mikkullehu, begin deihu kegavvna dechivya, deshatik tadir, vekatil levatar.

Rugeza telitaa, hay ihu rugeza behippucha mikkadmaa, deazla veittakaf vela shatik, ella itgele hahu rugeza, vechol man deitgele hachi ittevar kol ma deitgele vela shatik, hachi ittebar, vehachi ikre rugeza tevira.
Rugeza reviaa, sheruta takkif, sofa tavir. veal da hay ihu rugeza, dimhafcha min kadmayyta. begin kach, hay ihu sitra tevira mikkullehu. veal da, kolla ihu bedarga kadmaa.

Darga tinyayna, ihu darga denafik mechashocha, vehay ihu gon chashuch, dekayyeyma miggo hay chashocha begin decholla kayyeyma miggo chashocha. vekayyeyma bedargin yedian. vehay itpashat letatta bigvavnin yedian.

Bedarga da, kayymin telat mea sitrin, mitparshin da min da, vechullehu kelilan da beda. veaf al gav dimshanyayn da min da, veitgabberan (davar acher vaanaheran) da min da, kolla kalil da beda. uvegin kach, kol dargin yedian behay sitra leavasha.

Mehacha nafke kol illen mechabbelin deshatyayn bealma, veavde dina beitgalyay (davar acher bealma), al ovadin setimin deitavedu go chashuch bitmiru, veinnun shatyayn bealma, veavde dina beitgalyay behu. uvegin kach, kol illen deshatyayn bealma, veavde dina beitgalyay, kullehu kayymin bekavleyhu divne nasha, leitatteda tadir, gabbe innun chovin temirin dekaamaran, veinnun deikrun af vechemma, mitchabberan immehon veavde dina alayyhu divne nasha. hay itavid bealma, meillen mare dedina kidkamran.

Darga da kayyeyma go chashocha veeshsha, deihu raza chada, umiggo darga da, mitparshan kama dargin takkifin (guvrin) dekayyman techot sitra dirkia chada, deikre rekia uchama. darga telitaa, hay ihu rekia, demitpashsheta al kol innun dargin, deinnun sumakin kevavrda. veillen ikrun deroin dehay sitra.
Techot illen, mitpashshetin letatta dargin, ad dematu lego darga telitaa (sefer acher hahu rekia ukkama) begin deillen di bedarga tinyayna, nafke miggo hahu rekia uchama, veshatyayn bealma.
Illen mimina, veillen missemala. illen dimina, mitparshan litlat sitrin, deinnun (vaychi 241 amud alef) telat kishrin. veillen dismala, mitparshan litlat sitrin, deinnun telat kishrin acharanin.

Kishra kadmaa, kayyeyma leella. utenana chashocha berugeza, itkashar beh. hay kishra, it bah telat gavvnin chashochin, umeshanyayn da min da, veitkelilu da beda. vehay kishra, ihu kafif, vela itpashat (sefer acher itkafyay), bar lezimnin yedian, hay ikre evra.

Veihu kayyeyma bela shechichu, begin dela shachich, bar bezimna deyisrael mekarvin karbana letatta, begin divhahu zimna ishtekach hahu rugeza, veitkafyay letatta, veitchallash rugezeh. (davar acher tukefeh) vela yachil leshalletaa uleattekfa. vechad itchalash hay, keden kishra tinyayna, deihu beemtzaita la yachil lenatla uleanhaga.

Kishra tinyayna, da hu deikre zaam, hay kishra ihu denatil meatar laatar, veanhig lechol shear kishrin, vechol shear kishrin kullehu, itnahagan beh, vechullehu ittakafu behay kishra. hay ihu demanhig kol tzarin lealma, begin dechad itchabbar bedarga achara, lechabbeka lenukeba, keden nachte lealma, kol tzarin, vechol dachakin, vechol aku, deha la yachilu leshaltaa da bela da. vechullehu dargin, ityeyhivu lenukeba, leshalletaa, ulemiste alma, vei lav derachiv da al da, veitchabbar da beda, la yachlin leshalletaa.
Ta chaze, kad hava adam beginta deeden, leishtaddela befulechana demareh. nachat hay samael, vechol
985: Innun dargin deveh, vahava rachiv al hahu chivya bisha, begin leastaa lon. begin dehahu chivya dehava kaim techoteh, ihu akima leastaa, bene nasha, ulefattaa lon. begin dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:3) ki nofet tittofna sifte zara vechalak mishshemen chikkah. veda yahiv chela, veda avid umanuta bealma, veda bela da la yachle leshalletaa.

Begin kach, kad hahu kishra deemtzaita, itchabbar benukeba, keden nachte dinin, vechol dachakin lealma vechad hay la ittakkaf dela natil, kolla ittevar veitkafyay, dela yachil leshalletaa. veal da, kolla ittebar veitkafyay, beraza dekarbenin diltatta. vesalleka man desalleka, leitattera leella, uleitbarcha meimka illaa, denahir lechol anpin.

Kishra telitaa hay ihu takkifa bitkifu yattir, vehay ikre tzara, begin demehay nafke shuletanu, leashraa dachakin, ulemebad aku livne nasha. veraza ditlat kishrin illen, dichtiv, (Tehillim 78:49) evra vezaam vetzara. illen telat kishrin dimina.

Telat kishrin dismala, kad mittakfe kachada, keden hahi semala ikre, (Tehillim 78:49) mishlachat malache raim. begin demehay semala, ishtadaru letatta, venatle tukepa, kol innun malachin bishin, innun denafke missitra diltatta, kidkamran. vechol da miggo darga tinyayna vedarga telitaa.

Darga reviaa, hay darga kayyeyma, miggo akimu derugeza, gon eshsha. vehay ikre emtzaita. deihu gufa, dekayyeyma ben teren deroin. hacha it lahata, dimlahata besumaka kevavrda. mehacha nafke tekifu lenachta letatta, leatkefa leoshada damin. begin dehay ihu deyahiv reshu veshuletana letatta, leatkefa uleoshda damin. hay nevia lenukeba, veda itzterich leda, kema deitzterich gufa lenafsha, venafsha la avid umanuta, ella begufa. veal da, kol chela, vechol tekifu, mehacha nafik, leatkefa, ulemebad umanuta bealma, leavasha. kenukeba dimkabbela min dechura tadir.

Bechol darga vedarga, uvechol kishra vekishra, it kama memanan, vechama terike chavilin, dechullehu itnahagan beginayyhu, vechullehu deitnahagan beginayyhu, kullehu letatta, deinnun chayyaylin di benukeba, vechullehu it lon darga yedia leella leitnahaga beh.

Kema deit lesitra illaa kaddisha, hechalin yedian, legabbe dargin ilain, leitkallela illen beillen, hachi name letatta (sefer acher bechashocha) behippucha, besitra achara, it dargin, legabbe innun hechalin denukeba, leitkallela illen beillen.

Behay darga, deihu reviaa, kayyman dinin bishin, lenachta letatta, uleitmasra leinnun deavdin dina bisha takkifa. mehacha yanke tukepa dilhon, leatkefa, uleashlema hahu dina deavde. uvegin kach, kol hani dargin kelilan behu, bechol innun hechalin tattain, delistar nukeba diltatta. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, desatu archayyhu meorcha da, veazle batar dachalta dekudesha berich hu, leitkaddesha bikdushsha demarehon, zakkain innun bealma den, uvealma deate.

Darga chamishaa. hay darga itpelig litren dargin (sefer acher sitrin) yemina, usemala. (232 amud bet) veillen ikrun shokin, mitdabbekan leavasha ulemirdaf. begin dehacha tekifu dirdifu. dechol marin, vechol bishin, deradfe batrayyhu dechayyayvayya. vechad dina (sefer acher darga) da itkeriv, keden haratzim yatzu dechufim. veinnun ratzim innun letatta, lemirhat leavasha. vechol innun ikrun rodfim, veal da ketiv (Eicha 4:19) kallim hayu rodfenu minnishre shamayim.

Hay darga itpelag litren sitrin, limina velismala. telat kishrin innun limina. utelat (vaychi 241 amud alef) kishrin innun lismala, veillen kishrin, veinnun kishrin dekaamaran, kullehu mistakkelan laachora. begin deinnun kishrin illain
986: Kaddishin, kullehu (vayyetze 124) mistakkelan lego penimae legufa, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 7:25) vechol achorehem bayta. veillen kullehu mistakkelan laachora.

Ma ben hay lehay. ella illen kishrin, illain kaddishin kullehu beraza deadam, uvegin decholla ihu beraza deadam, kol achorehem bayta ketiv. veillen kishrin acharanin dekaamaran, innun kishrin deemtzaita, kullehu mistakkelan laachora, veillen innun beraza divhema. uvegin kach kol achorehem laachora. veraza da kema (239 amud bet) deokimna, (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai. da besitra deadam, veda besitra divhema. vekarbana hachi salleka, adam uvehema.

Kishra kadmaa, beh kayyeyma gavvna dachashocha go urefla, (sefer acher go taheyrea daavarepaylaa) detzamach beitlatyay techot avna dekayyeyma aleh, dela tzamach. vehay kayyeyma alayyhu dezakkae, deit behu zachyayn, vela it behu zechu daavahata leittatkefa behu, uleaggana alayyhu.

Vekashrin acharanin, radfe batar chayyayvayya desatu archayyhu mikkadmat dena, veradfe avatrayyhu, vechol innun dirshimu itchaze behu leishtemoda. begin dechol innun deitchazun leitannesha, chad malacha, shelicha kaddisha, di missitra digvura, nachit verashim behu reshima, vehahu reshima ishtemoda leella, legabbe kol innun marehon dedina. vechad hahu reshima ishtemoda legabbayyhu, man deitchaze lemarin, alke leh bemarin. man deitchaze lemachovin, velishar onashin, kolla chaman behahu reshimu.

Uvegin da, innun kishrin kullehu kayymu laachora, uvaate beinnun devaate bemarehon, uvechol innun deitchazun levaata behu. bar tzaddike vachaside veit lon zechu daavahan, demarin radfin avatrayyhu, deillen la shalte behu, vela ate lon marin missitra da.

Vei tema, mean atar ate lon marin. ta chaze ketiv, (Yeshayahu 53:10) vaAdonai chafetz dakkeo hecholi. vaAdonai chafetz, dakkeo, itree lemachaa leh, ulemehav leh marin, begin lezakkaa lon lealma deate, vela missitra achara, veillen ikrun yissurin deahava, vecholla bechad matkela dekudesha salleka.

Darga shetitaa. hay ikre arla. veda, vechol innun dargin tattain, letatta, kullehu ikrun arla, begin deyanke missitra da. vehay ihu go raza denachash bariach. vehay yanik, lehahu nachash akallaton. vechullehu dargin acharanin, deitachadan behay sitra, ikrun guharke dearla. vecholla beraza chada ka azle.

Veta chaze, al da, kol innun ilanin deitnetau beara, ad la ishterashu, sharya alayyhu rucha missitra dehay arla, veal da ketiv, (Vayikra 19:23) vaaraltem arlato et piryo shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim lo yeachel. begin dekudesha berich hu, chavivuta deyisrael tadir legabbeh, verachik lon, mikkol orchin bishin, vesitrin bishin umesaavin, leitdabbeka besitra dikdushsha. zakkain innun behay alma vezakkain innun bealma deate.

Hechalot missitra dikdushsha amar ribbi shimon, ha tanenan beinnun hechalin, deinnun kayymin, lesaddera siddura dishvacha dekudesha berich hu ben siddura dekayyeyma bemilla ben siddura dekayyeyma biruta. begin deit siddura dekayyeyma bemilla, veit siddura dekayyeyma biruta vechavvavna delibba, leminda uleistakkela, begin leistakkela leella leella ad en sof, detamman (139 amud alef) tekiu dechol reutin umachashavin, vela kayymin bemilla kelal, ella kema deihu satim, hachi kol milloy bistimu.
Ta chaze (Bereshit 41 amud alef) hay deamaran beinnun hechalin kullehu (nusach acher talyayn), kol innun siddurin innun kelala chada, begin leitkallela tattae beillae.

Aval ta chaze, moshe kad sidder tzeloteh beginehon deyisrael, arich behay tzelota, begin deihi tzelota dekayyeyma leella. vechad sidder tzeloteh biktziru deachteh, la arich bah, begin dekayyeyma letatta. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:13) el na refa na lah, vla arich yattir, begin (Bereshit 91 amud bet) deihu mare deveta, ufakid beteh kadka chazi,
987: Uvegin kach la arich yattir bevauteh. (nusach acher veal da kullehu) vechullehu siddurin, leashraa shechinta bealma, kema deokimna bechol innun (shear) hechalin dekaamaran.

Rabbi shimon kam veamar, zakkaa chulaka dilach adam kadmaa, berira dechol nivrain, dekayymin bealma, derabbe lach kudesha berich hu al kolla, veail lach beginta deeden, veatkin lach 7 chuppot beh, leishtashea beinnuga denoam illaa, kema deat amer (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo. lachazot benoam Adonai leella. ulevakker behechalo letatta. lachazot benoam Adonai, beinnun shiva rekiin leella, ulevakker behechalo beinnun shiva rekiin diltatta, veillen kayymin illen lokovel illen.

Uvechullehu kamt beginta deeden. innun shiva chuppot illain kaddishin, kayymu alach leella, leitattera behu. veinnun 7 tattain, kamt behu leishtashea behu, uvechullehu ashlim lach marach, lemeheve shelim becholla.

Ad deitdechu raglach, batar eta dehahu chivya bisha, veittaracht migginta deeden, vegaramt mota lach, ulechol alma, begin deshavakt illen iddunin dilella vetatta, veitmashshacht batar innun kisufin misavin, deikrun (Iyov 20:16) rosh petanim, degufa mashich behu, vela rucha. kema deat amer, (Devarim 32:33) verosh petanim achzar. uchetiv anavemo inneve rosh. ad deata avraham chasida, veshari leatkena alma, veal go mehemnuta kaddisha, veatkin leella vetatta, beinnun rekiin illain, uveinnun rekiin tattain.

Innun tattain, hechalin leinnun rekiin illain, leitachada da beda, uleitkashshera da beda, kema deokimna beinnun hechalin dekaamaran. veaf al gav deokimna hatam go kelala, hacha it lan lefarta millin, uleatkena leyichuda kedka yeot, begin dela yitun chavrayyay, veyehachun beorach meshar, kema dichtiv (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu bam vegomer.

Hechal livnat hassappir yesod vaatara hechala kadmaa. sheruta go mehemnuta, vehay ihu sheruta leraza dimhemnuta, uvedargin dechezu dimhemnuta. nevie keshot, havo chaman miggo da asfakalarya deena meira, uvegin dehay ihu sheruta dimhemnuta, ketiv (Hoshea 1:2) techillat dibber Adonai behoshea. dechama miggo darga da, deihu sheruta dechol dargin lesalleka leella, vesofa dechol dargin lenachta letatta.

Uvegin dehoshea chama miggo sheruta da, sofa dechol dargin, itzterich lenatla hay eshet zenunim, begin deyisrael itdachu veitmeshachu mitamman letatta, legabbe hahu atar deikre eshet zenunim, begin deshavku, vela itdabbaku behay eshet chayil. vechama mitamman kol innun hechalin deinnun besitra mesaava. (deit leh)

Hechalin dimsaava, kullehu misavin leman deitdabbak behon, veal da ketiv, kach lecha eshet zenunim vegomer. vechi nevia dikshot itzterich leda. ella, begin deasir leh levar nash leaala beinnun hechalin, begin dela yitmeshach avatrayyhu, kegavvna deavad noach, dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:21) vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal.

Vehoshea dachil leistakkela beinnun hechalin deisteavu behu yisrael veitdebaku, dela yitmeshach avatrayyhu, kema dichtiv benoach vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal. ad deamar leh, kach lecha eshet zenunim veyalde zenunim. uchetiv vayyelech vayyikkach et gomer bat divlayim. leminda bema deitdebaku veisteavu, veshavku raza dimhemnuta, begin (243 amud alef) el nichar. veal da, chama migo hechala da, sheruta dechol dargin.
Hechala da, sheruta decholla, lesalleka bedargin. hay hechala, ihu madora dekayyeyma binhiru. leitattera bedargoy, leistakkela beinnun dargin illain, dichtiv, (Shemot 24:10) vayyiru et elohe yisrael.

Behay hechala, chad memana shamasha tahariel shemeh. veihu kayyeyma al pitcha dehahu hechala, vechol nishmatin desallekin, kayyeyma hay memana behay pitcha, vechamma memanan acharanin immeh, kullehu eshsha dimlahata, vesharvitin deeshsha (212 amud alef) bidayyhu, vechullehu
988: Mare deayynin. hay memana kayyeyma besitra da, i zachaat hay nishmeta lemeal, hay memana patach pitcha vealat.

Vei la zakkaat, hahu memana achara dekayyeyma besitra achara, zammin, vechamma elef verivvan gardine nimusin immeh. dache lah hahu memana achara kaddisha, venakit lah hay achara, di besitra dimsaava, veail lah go innun hechale misave. vechol innun gardine nimusin achde lah, ad denachte lah lagehinnam, veitdanat tamman teresar yarche. tikkuna dehahu sitra achara, be dina leatdena behu chayyayvayya.

Kegavvna da, hahu memana kadisha, dekayyeyma al hahu pitcha, kol innun tzelotin, devake avirin urekiin, lemeal kamme malka, i tzelota desagiin innun, patach pitcha, veail hahu tzelota ad deitavedu kol tzelotin dealma, atara beresha detzadik chay almin, kema deukemuha.

Vei tzelota deyachid, salleka ad demate lefitcha dehechala da, dehay memana kayyeyma beh. i yaa hahi tzelota, leaala kamme malka kadisha (yeot), miyyad patach pitcha, veail lah. vei la yaa, dache lah levar, venachta veitteshatya bealma, vekayyeyma go rekia tattaa meinnun rekiin diltatta, dimdavre go alma, uvehahu rekia, kayyeyma chad memana di shemeh sahadiel, umemana al hay rekia. venatil kol hane tzelotin deitdachyayn, deikrun tzelote pesilan veganiz lon, ad deittedan (nusach acher detav) hahu bar nash.

I tav legave mareh kedka yeot, vetzalle tzelota achara zakkaa, hahi tzelota zakkaa kad salleka, natil hahu memana sahadiel hay tzelota, vesalik lah leella, ad deira behahi tzelota zakkaa, vesallekin veitarvun kachada, vealin kamme malka kadisha.

Ulezimnin itdachya hahi tzelota, begin dehahu bar nash itmeshach batar sitra achara, veihu isteav behahu sitra, venatil lah hahu memana di behahu sitra achara mesaava. ucheden kayyeyma hahu sitra achara mesaava. salik veadkar chovoy dehahu bar nash kame kudesha berich hu, veaste aleh leella. veal da, kol tzelotin, vechol nishmatin, kad sallekin, kullehon sallekin vekayyman kame hechala da. vehay memana kayyeyma al pitcha dehechala da, leaala nishmatin utzelotin, o ledachyay lon levar.

Leella mehay pitcha, it pitcha achara, dekudesha berich hu chatir lah veitpetach telat zimne beyoma, vela anil, vekayyeyma leinnun marehon detiuveta, di oshdin dima bitzlothon kame marehon. vechol tarin ufitchin ninalu, ad deayyle birshuta, bar tarin illen, deikrun share dima.

Vechad hay tzelota dedima salleka leella, leaala beinnun tarin, izdaman hahu ofan dekayyeyma al shit mea chevavn ravrevan, verachamiel shemeh, venatil hahi tzelota, beinnun dimin, tzelota alat veitkashsharat leella. veinnun dimin ishtaaru hacha, ureshimin behay pitcha.

Veit dimin acharanin, ureshimin tadir al kol innun retichin illain, dela itmechun (sefer acher atechamevan). illen innun dimin, deoshdu leella vetata, kad itcharav be makdesha, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutza malache shalom mar yivkayun. veinnun dimin deoshdin al tzadikayyay, vezakkain, kad mistalleke mealma. kullehu natle lon innun retichin, vearve lon beinnun dimin, deitoshdu al charivu deve makdesha veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim. man panim. illen retichin illain kadishin. ulevatar vecherpat ammo yasir meal kol haaretz ki Adonai dibber.

Behay hechala, it ruach deikre (233 amud alef) situteriya, vehay ihu chezu safira, denatzitz lechol evar, vehay ihu dekayyeyma litren sitrin, umeillen mitparshan netzitzin kintzitzu desharga, kema (Bereshit amud alef) deokimna bechamma sitrin. vechamma
989: Kad hahu rekia illaa, nahar denagid venafik meeden, afik nishmatin, leaala go hechala sheviaa leella, hahu hechala sheviaa nakit lon. vechad nafke innun nishmatin kadishin, migo hahu hechala sheviaa, nachtin ad dematun lehay hechala, venakit lon hay rucha kadisha sitturiya (299) shemeh, deihu limina. vechol innun nishmatin dechurin, deinnun zeminin leitparcha bezakkain dechurin, limina kullehu nakit lon, umitakkeve tamman, ad deitkelilu benishmatin denukeve.

Mehay rucha nafka (260 amud alef) rucha achara, lismala. deitchaze veitgeniz veitkelil behay rucha kadmaa, veinnun chad, kelilan da beda. vehay rucha achara, ikre adiriyyah sanugeya. 138 (nusach acher sanevageya satenayh) hay ihu rucha lismala. vehay kayyeyma, dechad tiuveta dehechala sheviaa leitdabbeka (258 amud alef) behahu nahar denagid venafik, hahu reuta desalleka mittatta leella, avda nishmatin biruta dileh, veinnun nukeve.
Vechad reuta dehahu nahar, nachta veitdabbeka meella letatta, avdin nishmatin dechurin. reuta dilella avid dechurin. reuta diltatta avid nukevin.

Vechad illen nishmatin nukevin nafkin miggo hahu hechala sheviaa, nachtin (sefer acher nafkin) ad dematu lehay rucha semala, deikre addiriyyah. veikre livnat hassappir. kema deokimna besitrin acharanin.

Kevan dematu lehay rucha innun nishmatin nukevin, nakta lon hay rucha, vekayyman beh. ulevatar itkelilu rucha da dismala, berucha da dimina. ucheden itavidu innun nishmatin, kelilan dechar venukeba kachada (mizdavvevgan) ufarchan mehay hechala veitparshan bivne nasha. (24 ata leitkallela) kol chad kefum archeh, ulevatar mizdavvevgan kachada.

(24 Ata leitkallela) rucha da dismala bimina, batash da beda leitkallela. venafke netzitzin demitpashshete lechol evar, veitavidu innun ofannim minnayyhu, meinnun netzitzin denafke miggo rucha semala, dichtiv behu, (Yechezkel 1:16) mare haofannim umaasehem keen tarshish. veillen innun ofannim dimlahatan eshsha, vekayymin beshirata.

Kevan deitbesamu rucha berucha, veitkelilu kachada, keden nafka chad nehiru desalleka venachta, umityashsheva al arba shurin deofanim, veihu chad chevata deshalta alayyhu, veikre bazak, hay bazak nahir binhora denatzitz go shalhova, veshalta al kol innun ofannim.

Veitpashshat minneh chad rekia, dekayyeyma al teren samchin, veinnun teren samchin innun teren keruvin, chad missitra da, vechad missitra da. vehay rakia al reshayyhu, kema dichtiv, (Yechezkel 10:1) vaere vehinne el harakia asher al rosh hakkeruvim. velav hay rakia deal resh chevata. vehay bazak memana aleh, verucha illaa deitkelil, al kolla.

Kol innun tzelotin, dimkaddeme al la sayyme yisrael kullehu tzelotehon, mitakkeve behay rekia, vehay bazak deshalta al hay rekia, metakken lon. ad deata sandalfon rav memana, ruach illaa, deshallit al kolla, vechad sayyme yisrael kullehu tzelotin, natil lon mehay rekia, vesalleka vekashir lon kishrin (vechitrin) lemareh kema deukemuha.

Hay bazak, kaim lemimne kol innun tzelotin desalkan, vechol innun mille deorayyta demitatteran belelya, kad rucha detzafon atar, velelya itpelag kol man dekaim behahi shaata, veitasak beorayyta, kol innun millin sallekin, venatil lon hay bazak, veanach lon behay rekia, ad desalleka yemama.

Ulevatar desalik yemama, salkan innun millin, vesharan baatar dirkia, deveh (Bereshit 31 amud alef) talyayn kochavaya umazzale shimsha vesihara. vehay ikre (70 amud alef) sefer hazzikkaron, dichtiv, (Malachi 3:16) vayyikkatev sefer zikkaron lefanav. lefanav, begin desefer vezikkaron ketav bekishshura chada.
Innun arba galgallin, innun natlin al teresar samchin. illen 4, ahaniel. kedumiel (sefer acher 161 131) yeahadonahi, (240 amud bet) yehadoniyya. di maftechan dishma kaddisha bidayyhu.
990: Beraza deatvavn (260 amud alef) adonay, di sandalfon mare retichin. mishtamesh behu. illen arba atvavn parchin baavira, dehahu avira kalil beatvavn dishma kaddisha, Adonai, yod hei vav hei. vehahu avira kalil lon, veitkelilu illen beillen. veillen 4 natlin lon, beraza dehahu bazak.

Veillen 4 alin bed, illen beillen, dichtiv, (Shemot 26:5) makbilot hallulaot echat el echat. veha okimna, veraza ihu leitkallela illen beillen, uleshalleva illen beillen, beraza dehahu rucha dechalil beraza dishma kaddisha. dechalil shema da bishma da.

Vecholla behay hechala mitnahage, venatle behahu rucha, beraza dishma kaddisha deshallit al kolla. behay hechala ihu yeahadonahi, kelala ditren shemahan, miggo deihu rucha berucha. vechad shema da, dechalil beraza derucha berucha, vechalil da beda. nahir da beda, keden nahir kolla, vesalleka nehora venachta, kinhora deshimsha go mayya vokimna.

Ucheden (24) hay rucha natil, kolla natlin begineh, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:12) el asher yihye shamma haruach lalechet yelechu lo yissabbu belechtan. vechad rucha da nahir bishma da, keden alin kullehu da beda, veitkashsharu kullehu kachada, lesalleka leella, beraza dishma da kaddisha.

Beemtzaita dehechala da, kayyeyma chad ammuda, naitz mehechala da lehechala tinyayna, behay salik rucha diltatta legabbe rucha dilella, leitachada rucha berucha, vechen ad leella mekullehu, lemeheve kullehu rucha chada, kema deat amer veruach echad lahem (lechol).

Ammuda da dekayyeyma beemtzaita, adrahaniel shemeh, verazin demaftechan dishma kaddisha bideh. kad tzelotin sallekan umatan lehay ammuda, keden natle kullehu deinnun behechala da, lego hechala tinyayna, leitachada da beda, lemehevi kolla beraza chada, leityaychada ella vetatta kachada lemeheve shema kaddisha shelim kedka yeot.

Hechal otztzom hashshamayim 15 hechala tinyayna hechala da, kayyeyma go raza dimhemnuta, leitachada beraza dilella. hay hechala, tamir veganiz yatir min kadmaa. behechala da, it telat pitchin, vechad shamasha memana alayyhu, urefaniel shemeh. hay memana, shallit al telat sitre alma, darom vetzafon umizrach. darom mehay sitra, vetzafon mehay sitra, umizrach beemtzaita.

Illen telat pitchin, litlat sitrin illen. teren setimin, vechad beemtzaita patiach, beraza dichtiv, (Shemot 24:10) ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar. hay memana itpekad vekayyeyma behahu pitcha deihu patiach, utechot yedeh teren memanan acharanin, dimmanan al innun pitchin acharanin setimin.

Vechol innun nishmatin, deinnun ketule bet din, o innun ketule shear ammin, kullehu itmanan techot yedehon, vehay memana dealayyhu, chakik lon lediyyukenehon bilvushoy, deinnun nur dalik, vesalik lon leella, veachme lon lemareh, ucheden natil lon, vechakik lon befurepuroy, leinnun ketule shear ammin.

Veinnun ketule bet din, nachit lon hay memana, veail lon batar innun teren pitchin setimin, deinnun teren memanan acharanin kayymin alayyhu, vetamman chaman yekara dechol innun dekayymu orayyta, venatru pikkodoy, veinnun kesifin begarmayyhu, venichvin mechuppa dilhon. ad dehay memana dekayyeyma alayyhu, patach lon tara demizrach, venahir lon, veyahiv lon chayyim deitpatachu behahu tara demizrach. uvida dehahu memana chad kassa dechayyin, deihu malya nehorin, vehay ikre kos tanchumin, kasa dechayye. (nusach acher venahir veyahiv lon chayyim) deha begin kassa achara deshatu bekadmita, zachu lehay.

Kegavvna da it besitra achara, behechala dimsaava, memana achara, uvideh kos deikre (Vayikra 12 amud bet, 264 amud alef) kos tarela, kos chamato. kema detanenan, it yayin veit yayin, hachi name it kos veit kos, vecholla, da letav, veda levish. yayin letav, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:15) veyayin yesammach levav enosh. veyayin levish, dichtiv, (Tehillim 75:9) veyayin chamar male mesech vegomer. kos letav, dichtiv, (Tehillim 116:13) kos yeshuot essa. kos
991: Levish, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 51:17) kos chamato kos hattarela.

Kema deit besitra dikdushsha, hechalin umemanan kolla letav, veruchin kaddishin vechol sitrin kaddishin. hachi name it bistar mesaava, hechalin umemanan kullehu levish, veruchin misavin, memanan, vechol sitrin misavin. veda lokovel da, kegon yetzer hattov veyetzer hara, vecholla beraza chada.

Hechala da ikre hechol zohar, begin deit beh rucha, deikre urefaniel. veihu zohar dela ishtanni, vekayyeyma binhiru setima, denahir meella, uvinhiru denahir letatta. vechad batash nehiru diltatta binhiru illaa, (nusach acher vechad nahir nehora binhora) nahir hay rucha, kegavvna dechezu deena, dechad mitgalgela, keden appik nehora denatzitz vezahara, hachi name hay rucha. veal da, hechala da ikre zohar.

Hay rucha deikre urefaniel, hay ihu denahir lehechala da, venahir lehechala kadmaa, begin dehahu rucha dehechala kadmaa, nahir beitgalya, behay (davar acher mehay) rucha deihu setimaa. da rucha natil leella venatil letatta, beraza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:2) chammuke (258 amud alef) yerechayich kemo chalaim. uma deamar chammuke yerechayich. begin deit rucha achara denafik minneh listar semala, veitkashar bahadeh. veal da ketiv chammuke teren. vehay rucha semala ikre hadarniel, veitkelilu da beda, kelilan kachada, veinnun etzem hashshamayim, dichlila beesh umayim.

Ketiv (Yechezkel 1:28) kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beyom haggeshem vegomer. hay rucha kadmaa urefaniel, deihu satim ben ella vetatta, venahir, ihu (Yechezkel 1:27) keen chashmal, hay ihu keen chashmal, ulezimnin ihu chashmal. begin deminneh kayymin kol innun serafim (81 amud bet) chevavn eshsha memallelan, chevavn dekayyme vela kayyme, veal da ihu chashmal.

Urefaniel dekaamaran, beda ishtemodan chayyin lealma. kad ittedan alma letav, keden nahir rucha da, vechol chayyin vechol chidu ishtechach, deha kevan dizchuta nafka, unehiru dinin keden rucha da anhir. vesimanich (Mishlei 16:15) beor peni melech chayyim.

Vechad ittedan alma bedina, (behahu zechuta) keden hahu sitra achara mesaava, shalta veittakaf, (sefer acher vechad itdan alma bedina behahu zechuta, keden hahu rucha achara shalta veatkef) vehay rucha igniz veitchashach, ucheden kol alma kayyeyma bedina veittedan. vecholla kayyeyma behay rucha. vesimanich (Daniel Adonai:6) vearkuvateh da leda nakshan.

Hacha kayyman, kol innun malbushin denishmathon detzaddikayyay, desallekin leitchazaa kamme marihon, ulekayyeyma kammeh. vechad nishmeta salleka umate lehay hechala, keden izdaman chad memana, deitpekad al innun levushin, vetzidkiel shemeh. deha bezimna debar nash avid pikudin deorayyta behay alma, kegavvna deihu ishtaddal garmeh, hachi itavid leh behay hechala leella, malbusha leitlabbesha beh, behahu alma.

Vechad nishmeta salleka, hahu memana natil hahu levusha dilah, veazil immah ad di mata lenahar dinur, di nishmeta itztericha leitsachyay uleitlabbena tamman, ulezimnin detava hahi nishmeta tamman veittokda, vela salleka kolla yoma, ad betzafra, kad atar rucha desitra dedarom, keden kayyme kullehu umitchaddeshan, veamre shirata, umezammeran kegavvna deinnun malachin deitavar (96 32 amud bet) shultanehon veittokdan, vekayyman umitchaddeshan kemillekaddemin, veamre shirata, (veazle lon) hachi name illen nishmatin.

Vei zakkaat hay nishmeta vesalkat. hay memana tzidkiel, natil lah lehay nishmeta, vealbish lah behahu levusha, veittaknat beh, vesalleka lekarbana al yeda demichael kahana, lekayyeyma tadir kol yomin kame attik yomin, zakkaa chulaka dehay nishmeta, dekayyeyma vezachat lehay.

Uvecholla, itmana hay rucha urefaniel dekaamaran, veihu shallit al hay hechala. mikkelala da, kad itkelil rucha berucha, uvatash da beda leitkallela kachada, itberiu innun shallitin acharanin deitmenan al alma, veillen innun serafim deshit gadpin. dimkaddeshe lemarehon telat
992: Zimnin beyoma. veillen innun dimdakdeke im tzaddikayyay, afillu kechad nima desaara. veillen innun dekayyme leanasha, behay alma uvealma deate. uleinnun dimzalzele lebar nash deolifu minneh afillu milla chada beorayyta, vela menahage beh yekar. ulechol innun demishtamshe, beman dekari shit sidre mishna, leyachada yichuda demarehon.

Kad mityashshevan rucha berucha, veitnaharan kachada. mehahu nehiru nafka chevata chada, deshalta al innun serafim, vearba techotah, deanpayyhu anpin denesher, hay chevata yofiel shemeh, veihi kayyeyma bechol raze dechachmeta, lechol innun maftechan dechachmeta kayymin beh.

Hay chevata, kayyeyma lemitba agra meim kudesha berich hu, lemehav lechol innun deradfe batar kol marehon dechachma, vaafillu mikkol bar nash, veolfe chachma leminda lemarehon, vehahu agra deyahiv livne nasha deradfe batar chachma leminda lemarehon.

Dechad nafak bar nash mehay alma, hay chevata nafka al 4 serafim meoffin, vetasat kammeh, vela shavik kol innun gardine nimusin di besitra achara, lemikrav bahadeh, vechamma innun shelichan dishlam, sacharaneh. veillen serafim kad natlin veitchazzeyayn, itkafyayn innun serafim nechashim, denafkan mehahu nachash degarim mota lechol alma.

Hay chevata kaddisha kayyeyma kad nishmeta salleka umatat legabbeh, keden shaal lah beraza dechachmeta demareh, uchefum hahi chachmeta deradif avatrah veadbak (sefer acher bah), hachi yahave leh agreh. vei yachil leadbeka vela adbak, dache leh levar, vela ayyla, vekayyeyma techot hahu hechala bichsifu, vechad natle gadfayyhu, illen serafim ditchotah, keden kullehu batshe begadfayyhu, veokdun lah veittokdat vela ittokdat, vekayyeyma vela kayyeyma, vehachi ittedanat bechol yoma, nehirat vela nehirat.

Veaf al gav deovadin tavin it lah, begin (Bereshit 132) delet agra behahu alma, keinnun demishtaddele bechachmeta, leistakkela bikara demarehon, velet shiura leagra, deinnun deyade chachmeta, leistakkela bikara demarehon. zakkaa chulakehon bealma den, uvealma deate, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:13) ashre adam matza chachma veadam yafik tevuna.

Rucha da, shalta al kolla. kolla kelilan bah, kolla istachyayn legabbah. hay chevata, shalta al arba acharanin, vearba galgallin lechol chad vechad. galgalla chada istache listar mizrach. vegalgalla chada istache listar tzafon. vegalgalla chada istache listar darom. vegalgalla chada istache listar maarav. vechol chad vechad bitlat samchin. galgalla delistar mizrach. chaniel shemeh. galgalla delistar tzafon, karshiel shemeh. galgalla delistar darom, azriel shemeh. galgalla delistar maarav, aniel shemeh. veinnun telat samchin deinnun lechol chad vechad, kullehu istachyayn leemtzaita. begin deemtzaita ihu natil lon, vechullehu natlu begineh deemtzaita.

Illen dekayyme beemtzaita, kullehu memanan beshirata. veillen dimina amre shirata, desalleka reuta leella, veamre kadosh. veillen dismala amre shirata, vesalke reuta leella, veamre baruch. kadosh leella, uvaruch letatta. illen dekayyme leella listar yemina, natle kedushsha, umitchabberan bikdushsha, bechol innun deyade lekaddesha lemarehon, beyichuda beraza dechachmeta. veillen dekayyme bismala, natle kedushsha, umitchabberan bechol innun dela yade lekaddesha lemarehon kadka yeot. vechullehu kelilan illen beillen beyichuda chada, umitkashsheran da beda, ad dechullehu itavidu kishshura chada, verucha chada, umitkashsheran beinnun dilella, lemehevi kolla chad, leitkallela da beda.

Meatar da, yanke kol innun marehon dechachmeta, dekayyman leminda (vayyeshev 151 amud bet, 257 amud bet) bemare, o beraza (tikun 11 amud bet, 21, 258 amud alef, amud alef amud bet, 262 amud alef) dechelma, begin dinviim yanke milella. veillen mare dechelma, o demare, yanke mehacha. vechad mitchabbera atra da beatra dilella bekishshura chada, keden neviim, yanke meella umittatta, bekishshura chada.
993: Uvegin kach, it mashal bemillayyhu, dela tzachtzecha nevuathon kedka yeot, kema dehava beh bemoshe, dehava tzichtzucha binvuateh becholla. begin dinhiru nafik meella, meatar dechol nehorin nafkin minneh, umata ledargeh, umittamman yanik nevuateh, venahir, ma dela hava keden lecholla, lechol shear neviin. innun marehon dechelma, marehon demare, kullehu yanke meatar da letatta, bela chibbura dilella, al yeda dedarga achara tattaa minneh deihu levar.

Kema dedarga dinviim dilella, la havo chaman leh neviim, bar al yeda dedarga achara tattaa. hachi name illen, darga diyniku dilhon ihu leella, behay darga tattaa, aval la itgalya lon, ella al yeda dedarga achara levar, deihu tattaa minneh, begin denafka mehay hechala, umata milla ad hahu memana dekayyeyma al tara dehechala da, umittamman lehahu memana ditchot yedeh, vechen ad (sefer acher kullehu) dechamma innun denatle hahi milla, veitarvu bahadah. veal da kad mata legabbeh devar nash, kama innun deitarve bahadah, veal da la tzachtzecha milla kadka yeot.

Kad mitchabberin illen arba galgallin, bearba innun di beemtzaita, keden kullehu ikrun chamudot. veinnun marihon, demare. uvegin kach, hay chevata dekamran, shalta alayyhu. uvegin kach, ikre daniel, ish chamudot. dichtiv, (Daniel 9:23) ki chamudot atta. vecholla raza kedka yeot. zakkain innun deyadin raze demarehon, lemehach beorach keshot, bealma den uvealma deate.

Hechal noga ntztzch hechala telitaa. hechala da, hechala dekayyeyma binhiru illaa, yatir al kol illen kadmae. behechala da kayymin arba pitchin, chad listar darom, vechad listar mizrach, vechad listar tzafon, vechad listar maarav. bechol pitcha ufitcha it memana chada, dekayyeyma memana al kol pitcha ufitcha.

Pitcha kadmaa, da pitcha dekayyeyma beh chad memana, malkiel shemeh. veihu shallita al kol innun pitkin, denafke mibbe dina demalka, leitdena alma. (behahu pitka) begin dehay ihu memana leashgacha behu beinnun pitkin, uteren sofrin techot yedeh, chad mimina vechad missemala.

Lehay, ityeyhivu tikkune pitkin leatkena, ad la yifkun mehay tara levar, veyitmesaru bida dehahu memana, di behechala kadmaa. deha mizzimna deitmesaru bida dehahu memana divhechala kadmaa, ha nafke mitamman, velet reshu leatava lon.

Deha miyyad izdaman memana desitra achara mesaava, mareh dedina kashya takkifa, dela merachem, vesangadiel (sefer acher vasehadeyal) shemeh, veihu memana al tara dehechala kadmaa (sefer acher geris achara, velo geris kadmaa) di besitra achara, deihu gehinnam, vechamma innun gardini nimusin memanan leshatya bealma, uzeminin lemebad dina.

Uvegin kach, kayyeyma hahu memana leayyna befitkin, veinnun teren sofrin dekayyme techot memana da, shammashiel vekamuel, illen sofrin leatkena pitkin, vehahu memana alayyhu deihu malkiel. begin divinnun hechalin di bistar achara mesaava, itpekidu memanan yedian, behippucha meillen memanan di behechalin illen, vechol innun ruchin vechol innun memanan, detamman, kullehu leavasha.

Ta chaze, hay sangadiel (sefer acher sahedayal) kad natil pitka, missitra dehahu memana dekayyeyma lefitcha kadmaa, patach chad pitcha, lesitra dachashocha, deikre beer shachat, vetamman memanan elef verivvan zeminin lenatla innun pitkin, vehay memana alayyhu. ucheden charozin nafkin, vechamma gardine shatyayn
994: Bealma, vehahu dina ishtelim, veal da, memana da kayyeyma leayyna befitkin, uleatkena nimuse pitkin, ad la nafku mehay pitcha, vehay pitcha ihu pitcha dedarom.

Pitcha tinyayna, da pitcha dechayyin umotin talyayn beh, begin dehay pitcha, chatmin chatimin dechol pitkin, dechevan defitkin ittekanu kedka yeot, chad shamasha zammin, gazriel shemeh, venatil pitkin behay pitcha tinyayna, vetamman chatmin lehu.

Memana chada kayyeyma al hahu pitcha, veazriel shemeh, vechol pitcha ufitcha itkere al shema dehahu memana deitpakkeda aleh. hay memana techot shuletaneh, utechot yedeh, teren shammashin di shemahon (sefer acher 284) sanuriyya, adiel. chad mimina vechad missemala. hahu mimina, beh talyayn chayyin. vehahu dismala, beh talya mota. uteren chotamin bidayyhu, chotam chayyim vechotam mavet. da kaim lesitra da, veda kaim lesitra da.
Hay pitcha satim kol yome shatta, uveyoma deshavta, uveyome dechadsha itpetach, leachazaa chayyim behahu chotama, detalyayn beh chayyim, begin deshabbat vechodesh chotama dechayyim itkeyyaym behu.

Beyoma dechippure, deyisrael kullehu kayyme bitzlotin uvautin, umishtaddele befulechana demarehon, satim hahu pitcha, ad shaata ditzlota demincha. kevan deavar hay tzelota demincha, meatar be dina dehechala dizchuta, chad avira nafka, ufitcha da itpetach, vehay memana dehechala da kayyeyma, veinnun teren shammashin chad mimina vechad missemala, vechotame dechayyim umota bidayyhu, vechol pitkin dealma kammayyhu, ucheden achtimu hen lachayyim hen lamavet. veda hu pitcha demizrach.

Pitcha telitaa, da pitcha dekayyeyma bekiyyuma, leminda kol innun di dina yavar alayyhu, ben lemarin, ben lemachovin, ben lemiskenu. dina dela kayyeyma lemota. kad tara defitcha da sagir, keden dina itreshim al bar nash, dela tayyvin leh, bar bechela ditzlota takkifa, vetiuveta shelim. dichtiv (Iyov 12:14) yisgor al ish velo yippateach.

Chad memana kayyeyma al pitcha da, vekaftziel shemeh, vehay memana al pitcha da, begin lesagra hay pitcha, al hahu bar nash, deitchaze leitannesha, begin dela yitkabbal bitzlota, ad deyetuv lekame mareh.

Uvehahu zimna deitgezar dina bivnoy dela chavu, beinnun ravyayn zeirin, chad memana shamasha techot yedeh, iriel shemeh, venafak vechariz listar semala, ad deitar chad rucha, deihu rucha difgimu, (264 amud bet) itbere bifgimu desihara, veikre askara, vehay ihu rucha dekayyeyma al darga (sefer acher pitcha) reviaa, behechala telitaa, di bistar mesaava, veda kayyeyma al kittula dilhon, veyitchaze lon leravye, keitteta dirviat leravye, vaachidat lon, vekatlat lon.

Ucheden hahi nishmeta, salleka, veachid lah hay memana, vesalleka lah lammana dekayyeyma al hechala reviaa, vehahu memana megaddela lon, veishtasha behu, vesalik lon leitchazaa kamme malka kadisha, bechol shabbat veshabbat, uvechol resh yarcha veresh yarcha, veitchazun kameh, veitbarchun minneh. uveshaata derugeza shalta, istakkal behu kudesha berich hu, vechayyis al alma.

Vechol innun ravyayn, dela ashlimu shenin, ad telesar shenin veyoma chad, kullehu itmesaru bida dehay, (264 amud bet) mittelesar shenin ad esrin, kullehu itmesaru al yeda derucha achara, deikre agiryson, denafka mehay nachash (sefer acher akima) amika, degarim mota lechol alma, veihu yetzer hara. meesrin shenin uleella, itdan bar nash mibbe dina, atar deikre zechuta, ihu begarmeh ata, uvechovoy itdan, veitmesar bida dehay chivya deihu malach hammavet.
(Begin deha measserin shenin uletatta, ad telesar shenin), hay rucha dekayyeyma
995: Beh kenachash, azil avatreh, da agirison dekaamaran. begin dela itnetir kad hava ravya dakik kedka yeot. vechame beh siman deyitpegim levatar. vehay itnetil bela reshu, veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispe belo mishpat. veraza da ketiv (Bereshit 1:31) vehinne tov meod, vetanenan, vehinni tov meod, da malach hammavet, deakdim leh ad la yitpegim levatar. vehay memana dekaim al hay pitcha, ail nishmateh vesalleka lah leella.

Mittelesar shenin uletatta, itdan al chovoy deavoy, veitmesar bida dehay askara dekaamaran. vechol chad vechad, hechala da lokovel hechala da. da behippucha min da, kidkamran, vehay pitcha ihu listar tzafon.

Pitcha reviaa, pitcha da kayyeyma leasvavta, veikre pitcha deasvavta, behay pitcha kayyeyma chad memana, (252 amud alef) pedayel shemeh. vehay kayyeyma al kol innun asvavtin dealma, uleaala tzelotin dechol innun mare demachovin umarin vetzarin, vehay ihu salik bechol (nusach acher lechol) innun tzelotin, veail lon kame kudesha berich hu.

Vehay ihu (Iyov 33:23) malach melitz echad minni alef, begin deinnun elef kayymin behahu pitcha, vehay chad minnayyhu, uchetiv vaychunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer. begin desalik behay (nusach acher lehay) tzelota, vekayyeyma melitz tov aleh devar nash, veadkar zechuteh deavad kame malka kadisha, begin dehay ihu dekayyeyma tadir letav, veal da, kol asvavta kayyeyma behay pitcha di pedayel memana beh. pitcha da ihu listar maarav. uvegin da, illen arba pitchin kayymin behechala da.

Behechala da kayyeyma rucha chada deikre noga, hay ihu rucha shallita behay hechala, kol ziva vechol tiuveta kayyeyman beh. hay rucha ihu kayyeyma lechol innun deit lon chulaka bealma deate, da attar leinnun nishmatin beziva diykara, begin leminda kol innun ruchin di behechalin acharanin, deda ihu bar alma deate, veyyavar bechullehu, velet man deyimche bideh.

Hay rucha, ihu rucha dachya, barir meillen tatain, zahariel shemeh, mehahu mishcha dirvut kudesha denagid mealma deate, nagid beh, umehahu mishcha itbare (nusach acher itrabbe) veatzmach. vehay ihu ner, kema deat amer (Tehillim 132:17) arachti nir limshichi. begin dehay ihu siddura leadleka butzinin mitatta leella, kad shara aleh nehiru denagid milleella, begin dehay itsadar, kad itkelilu beh kol innun tattain letatta.

Vechad itsadar hay rucha bechol innun tattain, venahir, keden afik minneh nehora chad, di shemeh akariel (sefer acher 51) vehay kalil berucha da, hay kayyeyma techot (sefer acher hay) rucha, leamshecha (sefer acher laamashechaa) lechol innun nishmatin desallekin, deit lon chulaka bealma deate, veitchazun lesalleka leella.

Begin dechad nishmeta salleka, vealat beinnun hechalin tattain, reshima ihi beesrin (210 amud alef) uteren atvavn deorayyta, dirshimin behay nishmeta. vechad nishmeta zachat vekamat kammeh dehahu rucha, da memana ahadiel mashach lon. vesalkin vealin behahu nehar dinur vesallekin veitkerivu lekarbana.

Hay nehora kalil bitlat nehorin, begin dehahu revut mishcha, itkelil bitlat gevavnin. vechad natzitz hay nehora, natzitz minneh esrin uterin (atvavn) nehorin, lokovel 22 atvavn deorayyta, dirshimin behay nishmeta. veillen esrin uteren nehorin, kullehu memanan shammashin dekayyme immeh, vechullehu itkerun al shema dehay nehora dealayyhu, vechullehu itkelilu beh. hay nehora bechol innun nehorin, itkelil behay rucha, vehay rucha kalil beh, veistache leityashsheva go hechala reviaa.
Rucha da, kad itkelil minnehora da, umichullehu nehorin, kad dachayyayn (nusach acher dachakin) leitnatztzetza
996: Nafka minnayyhu chad chevata kadisha, kelila bitre gevavne, arya venishra, veihi chad diyyukena, vehay ikre ahiel. (sefer acher 442)

Vehay chevata kadisha, nafke minnetzitzu dilah, kad mate nehiru dehay rucha illaa bah, arba ofannim, kelilan bechol gevavnin, veinnun haderiel, yehadriel, ahadoriya, (hakedama 14 amud bet) asimon (nusach acher 116). kol illen bitmanya gadpin, veillen innun memanan, al kol chele shemaya, maggiche kerava. begin dela ishtechach kerava bealma, o akiru demalchuta meatrayyhu, ad dechele shemaya, vechochavayya dishar rekiin, kullehu achziu keravin vesichsuchin illen beillen. veillen arba ofannim, kayyme alayyhu learba sitrin dealma.

Illen arba, kad natlin leaggacha keravin, meraza dehechala dilella natlin, deihu be dina, veikre zechuta. mizzia dilhon appiku kama chelin umashshiryayn delet lon chushebana. vechullehu kayyme techot illen ofannim.

Minnehon kayyme al shirata, uminnehon shelichan al alma. lokovel innun shelichan delistar mesaava, denafke miggo hahu hechala telitaa dilah, veinnun mekatrege alma leavasha. veillen ishtechachu lokovlayyhu, dela yishletun legabbe innun demishtaddele beorayyta, kema deat amer (Tehillim 91:12) ki malachav yetzavve lach vegomer. uchetiv al kappayim yissaunecha pen tigof baeven vegomer. da (Yeshayahu 8:14) even negef tzur michshol. hay ikre even negef tzur michshol. vehay ikre (Yeshayahu 28:16) even bochan pinnat yikrat, (Yeshayahu 28:16) tzur yisrael. vecholla kayyeyma da lokovel da.

Meraza dehechala telitaa di besitra achara, nafke teren ruchin, deikrun af vechema, umitteren illen, nafkin kol innun shelichan deazlin leastaa beni nasha mearcha dikshot, veillen innun dekayyeyman, veakdimu al bar nash, deka azil leorcha demitzva. veal da illen ofannim kayyman lokovlayyhu, begin leaggana aleh debar nash dela yitnazkun. meillen teren ruchin dachil moshe, kad hava nachit min tura, dichtiv, (Devarim 9:19) ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema.

Beemtzaita dehechala da, it atra achara, dekayyeyma leella leella, bearba pitchin, learba sitre alma, eser memanan lechol pitcha ufitcha, vechad memana alayyhu. vehay kalil binhora deikre ahadiel, vehay ihu ofan betoch haofan, meshullavan da beda.

Illen arbein, natle dina mibbe zechuta, lealkaa lehay nishmeta dechavat (sefer acher vabeaat) lealkaa. veillen kayyme beshalhove nura legabbe innun nishmatin, vetasin levar mehechala da, vealkan lenishmeta da, vekayyeyma nezifa levar, kol innun yomin deitgezarat alah, vela alat lefargoda.

Veillen arbaim, innun dekayymin vaanzifu umenaddin, lechol innun deappiku mippumayyhu milla dela itztericha, uvatar da appiku mippumayyhu milla kaddisha, milla deorayyta, umetanfe pumayyhu bah. veillen kayyme, umenaddin lon, vekayyme behay nidduyay arbein yomin, dela ishtema tzelothon.

Vechen lechol innun dechavu innun chovin, devayayn lenazfa, asara karozin nafke bechol yoma, umachreze bechol innun rekiin, uvechol innun chelin umashshiryayn, izdeharu biflanya deihu nezifa. nezifa ihu al chova peloni deavad, ad detav kamme marih, rachamana lishezvan.

Kad tav mehahu chova, mitkannefe illen arbein, vesharan leh. ucheden achrizu aleh, pelanya shara nezifa. mikkan ulehala tzelota alat. vead la tav, nazif ihu leella vetatta, unetiru demareh itade minneh. vaafillu belelya nishmateh nezifa, desatmin lah kol tare shemayya vela salleka, vedachyayn lah levar.

Hay ofan dekayyeyma al illen arbein, kad natil mata lehahu atar deikre (Melachim 1 14:28) ta haratzim. vechad al, alu immeh innun arbein, di memanan bearba pitchin, vesallekin kol innun meginnin di dahava. veillen innun malachin deikrun chashmalim. veinnun meginnin vesayyfin verumechin, derahate leaggana alayyhu deyisrael mishshear
997: Ammin, uleaggacha kerava behu, ulenakma lon kefum shaata, bela arichu.

Uvegin kach ikre ta haratzim, atar deinnun ratzim rahate, veochu leaggacha, ulenakma nukemin lokovel ratzim acharanin, derahate leavasha uleatrea mazzalin, leshalletaa alayyhu. veraza da, (Ester 3:15) haratzim yatzu dechufim. ratzim missitra da, veratzim missitra da, uveginehon, (Ester 8:15) vehair shushan tzahala vesamecha, o (Ester 3:15) navocha. i mekaddeme illen dehacha, hair shushan samecha. vei mekaddeme illen desitra achara, hair shushan navocha.

Veha okimna, divcholla kayymin illen lokovel illen, sitra da lokovel sitra da. uvegin kach, illen innun meginnin lecholla. kad sallekin illen beillen, nafak chad avera dilella, veitavidu kullehu magen chad. vesimanich, (bareasheytetav) anochi magen lach.

Teresar galgallin, innun desacharan go hechala da, veinnun ikrun serafim, ditren gavvnin, chivvavr vesumak, rachame vedina, illen innun kayyme leashgacha tadir, al kol innun mare detzaara, detzarin lon shear ammin, vedachakin lon, veikrun challonot. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:9) mashgiach min hachallonot.

Veillen kayyme leistakkela, kol innun dimtzallan tzelotayyhu, dimkaddeme leve kenishta, veitmenun meinnun asara kadmae. keden sallekin vechatvin lon leella, begin deillen ikrun chaverim legabbayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini.

Zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, deyade lesaddera tzelothon kedka yeot, begin dechad hay tzelota sharat leistalleka, illen sallekin behay tzelota, vealin bechol innun rekiin, uvechol innun hechalin, ad tara defitcha illaa, vealat hahi tzelota kame malka, leitattera. kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, kol innun dimtzallan tzelotin, umekaddeshe lemarehon biruta shelim, hay tzelota baya leappaka lah miggo machashava, uviruta demilula verucha, ucheden itkaddash shemeh dekudesha berich hu. vechad matat legabbe illen chaverim, kullehu natle lehahi tzelota, veazlan bahadah ad hechala reviaa, behahu pitcha. veillen meshabbechin behahu zimna dimtzallan tzelotin, umekaddeshe behahu zimna, illen innun di memanan bimama behu beyisrael, lemeheve immehon chaverim. (sefer acher velav belelya keinnun) uvelelya, beinnun acharanin, deamre shirata belelya.

Veta chaze ketiv, (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit. veha okmuha, begin demana birchan dekudesha berich hu, deihu aviv. kema dichtiv, (Devarim lak) sheal avicha veyaggedcha. uchetiv (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha. veukemuha.

Chaver hu leish mashchit, man ish mashchit. da ihu hahu ish, defagim lesihara. veikre (Mishlei 16:28) ish tahpuchot. (Tehillim 140:12) ish lashon. (Bereshit 25:27) ish yodea tzayid ish sade. vehay ihu ish mashchit, dehay ihu mana birchan mealma. uf hachi, man demana birchan mealma, chaver hu lehay ish mashchit kidkamran. veda hu raza, begin deitzterich leh lebar nash levarcha lekudesha berich hu, uletzallaa tzelota kadka yeot. begin deyitbarach shemeh kaddisha, veyitchabbar beillen chaverin kaddishin, vela yifgom tzeloteh. begin deyimna birchan mealma, veyitchabbar behahu chaver ish mashchit deihu mana birchan mealma, vegarim mota lechullehu.

Ketiv (Devarim 18:11) vechover chaver, may vechover chaver. hahu man deazil batar sitra achara, vecharash charshin, ihu mashich aleh rucha achara mesaava, veitchabbar behahu chavruta dehahu chaver ra, veshaari bechavruta bahadeh, hahu chaver ish mashchit. amay ikre chaver. begin divshaata deityeylid bar nash itchabbar immeh. vetadir kayyma bahadeh chaver. levatar, ithappach leh chaver, ish mashchit.

Vehachi it besitra dikdushsha, besitra dimina, chaver tov, deavid tivu immeh devar nash bealma den uvealma deate. veillen chaverim kayyme tadir aleh debar nash, bechavruta chada, leshezava leh, uleaggana aleh, ulemehve immeh chaverim, lekaddesha shema demarehon, ulezammera uleshabbecha kammeh. tadir.
998: Arba samchin acharanin, leinnun teresar dekaamaran, hane chaverim. veillen innun kayyme legabbe innun deyatin eta leavasha letzaddikayyay. af al gav dela avde, vesalke veode milla leella, uvatle lehahu eta, veillen ikrun erellim veaf al gav dechullehu itmenun leda, kol chad vechad itmana veitpekad al millin yedian. utechot illen let lon chushebana.

Illen arba, kayyme learba sitre alma, vechol chad kaim leashgacha alayyhu deyisrael. veillen ikrun charakkim, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 2:9) metzitz min hacharakkim. shema deillen arba deikrun charakkim, igael. iriya (nusach acher 292). ariel. yehirael. igael, ihu kaim listar mizrach, veda kayyeyma leashgacha al kol innun deavdin ovadin tavin, veal kol innun dimchashsheve machashava demitzva, af al gav dela yachle lemebad.

Iriya, kayyeyma listar darom. veda kayyeyma leashgacha, lechol innun dimnachame lemiskena, o detzaare libbayyhu aleh, af al gav dela yachle lemehav leh. uleinnun deazle leorcha demitzva. uleinun deavde chesed im metim. veihu kayyeyma kiuma deemet. vehay itmana leadkera leh leella, uleachaka diyyukeneh leella, leaala leh lealma deate.
Ariel, kayyeyma listar tzafon. veda kayyeyma leashgacha lechol innun dachashivu lemebad bishin, vela avde. o baan lemechote, veatu lemebad, veittakaf beyitzreh vela avid.

Yehirael, kayyeyma listar maarav. vehay kayyeyma leashgacha lechol innun delaan beorayyta. veayyle benayyhu lemile beorayyta leve rav. ulechol innun demistakkele al mera, kad ihu beve mareh. veashgachu aleh, veodiu leh deyistakkal bechovoy uveovadoy, veyetuv minnayyhu lemareh. begin dechol man deyishtaddal behahu mera, deyistakkal beovadoy, veyetuv betiyyuveta kame kudesha berich hu, ihu garim leh leishtezava, uleatava leh rucheh. veal da ketiv (Tehillim 41:2) ashri maskil el dal beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. may beyom raa, beyom ra mibbae leh. ella beyom raa, beyoma deshalta hahu raa lemesav nishmateh. ashre maskil el dal, da hu mera. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 13:4) madua atta kacha dal ben hammelech. uvegin kach, beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai.

Veillen (sefer acher inun demistakkele) deinnun mistakkele behahu mera, leatava leh mechovoy gabbe kudesha berich hu, kema deokimna. behechala da kayyeyma aleh, leashgacha. uveyoma desharya dina al alma, yishteziv minneh, kema deat amer beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. yoma deittemsar dina lehahi raa leshalletaa beh (al alma) vechullehu illen kayyme leashgacha. veal da ikrun charakkim.

Beyoma derosh hashshana, kad kudesha berich hu kaim bedina al alma, vehahu sitra bisha ate leastaa, keden mitkannefe kol hane, vekayyman kame kudesha berich hu. ucheden mitatteran kullehu, vekayyman kame kudesha berich hu. behahu zimna ma ketiv, mashgiach min hachallonot metzitz min hacharakkim. metzitz: keman deashgach meatar dakik, dechame vela chame kol ma deitzterich. ulevatar, mashgiach min hachallonot, atar ashgachuta yattir, defatach pitchin lerachama al kolla, vechad kudesha berich hu ashgach al alma, istakkal beillen challonot, uveillen charakkim, vechayis al kolla.

Ucheden kad yisrael takin behahu shofar veittear mittatta hahu kol denafik mishshofar, kalil meeshsha umaya verucha, veitavid mikkolla hahu kol, begin leitteara kol illaa, denafka miggo hahu shofar, deihu kegavvna da, kalil beeshsha uvemmaya verucha. keden karoza nafka, veachriz bechullehu rekiin, veamar kol dodi hinne ze ba vegomer, mashgiach min hachallonot metzitz min hacharakkim.

Ucheden yade kullehu, deha kudesha berich hu chayis alayyhu deyisrael, veamre zakkain innun yisrael, deit lon eta beara, begin leitteara rachame milleella, keden ketiv (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua, yode terua vadday,
999: Yode terua: metabbere hay terua, deihu dina kashya, decholla itdanu be. zakkain innun yisrael bealma den, uvealma deate, begin deinnun yade archoy dekudesha berich hu, veyade lemehach bearchoy, uleyachada yichuda kedka yeot.

Illen challonot, veillen charakkim, kayyme kullehu leachada kol tzelotin, desallekin mittatta leella, uleashgacha behu, leaala lon kame kudesha berich hu. veal da kol bet hakkeneset delav beh challonot, lav atar letzallaa beh kedka yeot.

Deha bet hakkeneset letatta, lokovel bet hakkeniset dilella. bet hakkeneset dilella deit beh (59 amud bet) challonot kema deamaran, hachi name letatta. leella keneset haggedola, it beh teresar challonot illain, hachi name lehay bet hakkeneset tattaa. vecholla kayyeyman da lokovel da, begin dealmin kayymin illen begavvna deillen, vekudesha berich hu salik yekareh becholla. veal da beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai, kad shalta hahi sitra bisha, yemalletehu Adonai.

Kegavvna da, hay memana yehirael, kayyeyma al kol innun dechayyse al miskene, kema deat amer ashre maskil el dal. uvegin da kolla kayyeyma behechala da, vehechala da itkelil behechala achara reviaa, detamman hu gizrin vedinin lecholla. zakkaa chulakeh man deyada ginze demareh, leyachada leh, ulekaddesha shemeh demareh tedira, lemizke leh bealma den uvealma deate.

Hechal hazzechut 216 hechala reviaa. hechala da, di kudesha berich hu ishtemoda shuletaneh beara begineh. veda ihu hechala, dekayyeyma lemetar archoy deorayyta. da hechala ikre dizchut, deveh itdanu kol dinin dealma, vechol zachyayn, vechol chovin, vechol onashin, vechol agar tav, leinnun denatre pikkude orayyta.

Hechol da dizchut, meshanyay michol shear hechalin, vehay hechala, kelilan beh arba hechalin, meshanyayn da min da, vechullehu chad hechala. behechala da it rucha chada, deikre zechut el. vehechala da ikre al shemeh zechut, vehay ihu el. vehacha itdanu kol dinin dealma, vehay ihu raza dichtiv, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom.

4 Hechalin, 4 illen deinnun behechala da, da lego min da, kullehu kelilan da beda, vechullehu chad hechala, veikre zechuta. arba hechalin illen, it lehu pitchin. chad memana illaa dekayyeyma levar lefitcha kadmaa dehechala da, sansaniyyah shemeh, veal shema da, it memana achara lesitra achara dismala, denatil dinin behahu hechala dileh, leatara lemebad bealma. uvegin denatil minneh, ikre al shemeh, sansaniyyah. veihu shallit al hahu askara deravye.
Vehay memana illaa sansaniyyah, kad natil dina, achriz leinnun memanan dekayymin al teresar pitchin, veinnun karozin demachreze kol innun dinin, deitdanu mehechala dizchuta da.

Rucha da denatil kolla, deikre zechut el dekaamaran, kolla kalil beh. minneh nafku shivin nehorin netzitzin, vechullehu beigula kayyme, begin leachazaa da beda dela itkase da min da. chol zachyayn, vechol onashin, vechol dinin, kame kullehu nehorin illen kayymin.

Minnayyhu nafke teren nehorin, dekayyme kamayyhu tadir. veillen 70 nehorin, uteren nehorin dekayyme kamayyhu, innun lego beemtzaita dehechala. veal raza dehechala da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:3) sharrech agan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg.

Lokovel innun nafke shivin uteren nehorin acharanin, missitra dimina. veshivin uteren nehorin acharanin, missitra dismala. veillen kadmae innun penimae lego, beemtzaita dehechala. lekamme nehorin illen, alin kol zachvavn vechol chovin leitdakkaa. kol ovadin dealma, meillen penimae nafke. ishtechachu kol nehorin denafke merucha da illaa, matan veshit sere nehorin, vechullehu kelilan berucha da.

Innun tere nehorin, dekayyme kame innun shivin, innun sahade sahaduta tadir, vechatve pitke dina dizchu o dechova. illen shivin innun gizrin gazre vedayynin dinin. vechol dinin dealma hen letav hen levish hacha ihu.
